Job Title

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician

Job Description Summary

Job Description

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that Better Never Settles. We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally, and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

C&W Services provides compelling benefits, including:

  • Weekly Pay
  • Comprehensive Benefits that start on your first day
  • Training, Development, and Advancement Opportunities
  • A Clean and Cutting-Edge Facility
  • A Safety-First Culture

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance Team repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safety: Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures.
  • Maintenance: Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more.
  • Monitoring: Create, assign, and close out work order with data including labor hours, equipment maintenance, and parts used. Track and store department inventory.
  • Support: Mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.
  • Communication: Maintain positive working relationships across all of the Operations facility.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment (MHE) or automated conveyor systems and controls.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures.
  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading.
  • 1+ years of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles.
  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project, with the ability to create and manage documents effectively.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus on Mechanical or Electrical field.
  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards.
  • Experience with robotic operation and maintenance.
  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions.

Physical Demands:

  • Must have ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment.
  • Ability to perform tasks wearing appropriate or required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite toe shoes.
  • Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment.
  • Involves movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day.
  • Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures.
  • Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day.

We're a global company with over 400 offices in 60 countries. We're proud of our diverse family of employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.

What’s Next?

Ready to take the next steps in your career? Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference!

description:
Director of Product Management – Portals and AI Experience

About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at

About the Role

LexisNexis Risk Solutions delivers data, analytics, and technology that help customers make informed decisions and improve outcomes across a range of risk-related workflows.

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the evolution of our digital experience platform. This leader will shape how customers interact with our solutions, driving innovation in user experience, workflow efficiency, and intelligent automation.

This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise software and consumer-grade experience design. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across design, engineering, and data science to deliver differentiated, high-impact solutions that enhance customer productivity and satisfaction.

Candidate can be remote in the continental US or hybrid from one of our US offices.

Responsibilities

Define Product Vision and Strategy

  • Develop and communicate a multi-year vision for our digital experience platform.

  • Drive initiatives that simplify how customers access insights, complete workflows, and achieve outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to modernize user interactions and improve end-to-end experiences, with an AI-forward philosophy for both assisting users and leveraging agentic workflows.

Lead Product Discovery

  • Establish continuous customer discovery as a core operating model.

  • Spend significant time with investigators, fraud analysts, collections professionals, compliance teams, and other users to uncover unmet needs and opportunities.

  • Build a deep understanding of customer jobs-to-be-done, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.

  • Work closely with our User Experience and UI Design teams to validate opportunities through rapid experimentation, prototyping, and iterative learning.

Deliver Innovation with AI and Automation

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to enhance user productivity and efficiency.

  • Partner with technical teams to bring new capabilities from concept to production.

  • Ensure solutions meet requirements related to security, compliance, and trust.

Deliver Exceptional User Experiences

  • Champion world-class user experience design and interaction design.

  • Bring consumer-grade usability, simplicity, and delight to complex investigative workflows.

  • Raise the organization's standards for design quality, product craftsmanship, and customer-centricity.

  • Ensure products are intuitive, beautiful, and outcome focused.

Lead Through Product Operating Principles

  • Promote outcome-oriented product management and evidence-based decision-making.

  • Empower cross-functional teams to solve customer problems.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement with focus on understanding customers and their problems.

What We're Looking For

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including leadership of product managers and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience leading significant digital product transformations.

  • Demonstrated track record of shipping beautiful, highly usable products — you care deeply about aesthetics, interaction design, and reducing friction.

  • Demonstrated success introducing AI-powered products, workflows, copilots, or intelligent automation capabilities.

  • Deep expertise in product discovery, customer research, experimentation, and product strategy.

  • Experience defining and measuring customer outcomes rather than feature delivery.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in consumer technology, digital platforms, marketplaces, fintech, productivity software, or other organizations known for exceptional user experiences. B2C background highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with fraud prevention, financial crime, compliance, collections, investigative workflows, or adjacent domains.

  • Experience applying modern product operating principles inspired by leading product organizations.

  • Experience working with generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, and conversational interfaces.

  • Background partnering closely with UX research and product design organizations.

  • Ability to travel 5-10%

title: Senior IT Applications Administrator
description:
Job Description

Position Title: Senior IT Applications Administrator

Position Reports To: VP of IT

Position Summary

The Senior IT Applications Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of business applications across the company. This position serves as a senior-level technical resource and subject matter expert for assigned applications, providing advanced Tier 2/Tier 3 support, leading application enhancements and implementations, and partnering with business stakeholders to develop technology solutions that improve business processes.

The Senior IT Applications Administrator independently evaluates complex business requirements, translates those requirements into scalable application solutions, and makes configuration and technical recommendations that support business objectives. The position works closely with business leaders, end users, IT teams, vendors, and other technical resources to ensure applications are secure, reliable, well-integrated, and aligned with evolving organizational needs.

This role is expected to take ownership of assigned applications and projects, provide technical guidance to less experienced team members, and serve as a key point of escalation for complex application issues.

Essential Functions

  • Serves as a senior-level subject matter expert for assigned enterprise business applications, providing advanced technical and functional guidance to IT and business stakeholders.
  • Provides Tier 2/Tier 3 application support, independently analyzing and resolving complex application issues and determining appropriate resolution strategies.
  • Owns the administration, configuration, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of assigned enterprise applications
  • Designs, configures, and maintains application functionality, workflows, business processes, user access, security roles, permissions, integrations, and other system settings based on complex business requirements.
  • Independently evaluates business requirements and translates them into effective, scalable application solutions while considering system capabilities, downstream impacts, data integrity, and long-term maintainability
  • Leads or serves as a key technical resource for application implementations, deployments, upgrades, enhancements, integrations, and major system changes.
  • Partners directly with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand business processes, identify system gaps, and recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Leads requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-production support for assigned application initiatives.
  • Develops and executes testing strategies, including unit, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing, to validate application changes before production deployment.
  • Investigates complex application issues, performs root-cause analysis, and develops permanent solutions rather than relying solely on workarounds.
  • Partners with development teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, consultants, and other technical resources to troubleshoot and resolve complex application and integration issues.
  • Evaluates application capabilities and new functionality and makes recommendations regarding enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and opportunities for improved utilization.
  • Maintains ownership of application documentation, including configuration documentation, process flows, technical procedures, support documentation, and standard operating procedures
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, standardize, and improve business processes through application functionality and technology solutions.
  • Participates in application architecture and solution discussions, providing recommendations regarding configuration, integrations, data flow, and system design within areas of responsibility.
  • Assesses the potential business and technical impact of application changes and proactively identifies risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Provides guidance, training, and technical support to application users and less experienced IT team members.
  • Serves as a mentor and resource to other application support personnel, sharing technical knowledge, troubleshooting approaches, and application best practices.
  • Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with business stakeholders, IT leadership, vendors, and technical partners.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of supported applications and the business processes they enable, serving as a trusted advisor regarding application capabilities and solutions.
  • Supports application governance, data integrity, security, access management, and compliance requirements within assigned systems.
  • Stays current on application functionality, industry practices, technology trends, and vendor product roadmaps to identify opportunities that may benefit the organization.
  • Takes ownership of assigned application-related projects and initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, dependencies, and communication with stakeholders.
  • Supports continuous improvement initiatives and contributes to the development of application strategies and roadmaps.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience supporting, administering, configuring, implementing, or optimizing enterprise business applications.
  • Demonstrated experience independently administering and configuring enterprise applications in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience providing advanced Tier 2/Tier 3 application support and resolving complex technical and functional issues.
  • Experience leading or serving as a technical lead for application implementations, deployments, upgrades, integrations, or major enhancements.
  • Experience gathering and analyzing business requirements and translating them into application solutions.
  • Experience working directly with business leaders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to design and implement solutions.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS applications and business systems.
  • Experience with Salesforce strongly preferred.
  • Experience with application integrations, workflows, security roles, permissions, and system configuration preferred.
  • Experience mentoring, guiding, or providing technical direction to other team members preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong ability to independently analyze complex business and technical problems and develop effective solutions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application administration, configuration, integrations, implementations, and application lifecycle management.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and sustainable technology solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce and/or other enterprise business applications.
  • Ability to evaluate the downstream impact of application configuration and technical decisions across business processes.
  • Strong project leadership and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong business partnership and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and make recommendations within areas of responsibility.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to system accuracy, reliability, security, and data integrity.
  • Ability to research unfamiliar technical issues, identify appropriate solutions, and apply sound technical judgment.
  • Ability to mentor and provide guidance to less experienced team members.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business requirements, technology environments, and organizational priorities.

Working Conditions/Physical Demands

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Frequently required to use a computer and other office technology for extended periods.
  • Ability to communicate through telephone, video conferencing, email, and other electronic communication platforms.
  • Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 pounds.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

title: Cabling Technician
description:
Summary

Installs, modifies, repairs, and maintains voice, data and video cabling systems under direction and supervision of Lead Technician. Assists with surveying installation areas to determine work methods, tools, and materials.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Installs Category 3, Category 5, Enhanced Category 5, Category 6 and Fiber Optic Structured Cable Distribution Systems.

  • Installs outlets, pulling cable, fire stopping and pre-termination including organizing, forming, dressing and labeling cables to industry standards.

  • Terminates, assembles and installs 8-pin modular connectors and coaxial connectors, lightcrimp connectors and optical fiber ST and/or SC ceramic connectors.

  • Tests copper and fiber (multimode and singlemode) cables to required certification parameters utilizing appropriate test equipment as required.

  • Diagnoses and corrects copper and optical fiber problems.

  • Removes and demolishes abandoned cables.

  • Maintains and references industry standards including ANSI, EIA/TIA, and local. BICSI and National Electric Code.

  • Installs grounding infrastructure and performs grounding tests.

  • Performs cable splices for copper and optical fiber (mechanical and fusion).

  • Identifies active circuits.

  • Attends training and safety meetings. Works safely at all times utilizing necessary Personal Protection Equipment.

  • Functions as “lead” in absence of Lead Technician if directed to do so.

  • Demonstrates basic knowledge of LAN/WAN topologies, cabling standards and components.

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.

  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.

  • Ability to work extended hours including evening/weekend (overtime) as needed.

title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL or Sr. MSL), Neurology-Alzheimer's Disease, South Florida and Puerto Rico
description:
At Eisai, satisfying unmet medical needs and increasing the benefits healthcare provides to patients, their families, and caregivers is Eisai’s human health care (hhc) mission. We’re a growing pharmaceutical company that is breaking through in neurology and oncology, with a strong emphasis on research and development. Our history includes the development of many innovative medicines, notably the discovery of the world's most widely-used treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. As we continue to expand, we are seeking highly-motivated individuals who want to work in a fast-paced environment and make a difference. If this is your profile, we want to hear from you.

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL or Sr. MSL) is a field-facing representative of US Medical Affairs with a primary responsibility of engaging in the exchange of scientific data and other medical and/or scientific information with KOLs/HCPs, researchers, pharmacists, and decision makers in the areas of Eisai’s interest. The person in this position will demonstrate a thorough understanding of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), including the needs, issues and priorities as they relate to Eisai’s strategic medical plan. MSLs will be trained and certified on AD and Eisai’s dementia pipeline data in order to fulfill educational gaps with KOLs/HCPs and gather medical insights to refine medical strategy and continue to close the gap on unmet educational needs for AD HCPs. MSLs also assume responsibility for special internal/external projects as they arise.

The impact that a Medical Science Liaison will have on the organization includes the following: a) as a representative of Eisai, a MSL will communicate key information about Eisai, the company and its hhc mission; b) provide key scientific and clinical information about Eisai’s products/pipeline; serve as a conduit for communication between Eisai Research and the medical community regarding ideas for future research, and c) provide corporate value through demonstrated leadership, teamwork, participation in strategic thinking, and special projects.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

​


Product/Therapeutic Area Support to Stakeholders

· Act as the primary clinical/scientific resource to HCPs in the territory for information pertaining to disease state and Eisai's product(s) to ensure awareness and understanding.

· Serve as a conduit for accurate and updated clinical, scientific and medical information between Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)/investigators and the company's Medical Affairs and development groups.

· Establish, foster, cultivate and maintain peer relationships with KOLs in AD and dementia in which Eisai has current and future interests.

· Present clinical and scientific data on Eisai’s products and relevant therapeutic areas, as requested.

· Support assigned professional congresses in accordance with MSL plan. Be prepared to lead congress coverage efforts, including coordination of all MSL activities.

· Identify and report key scientific, clinical and research insights from KOLs to Medical Affairs.


Training/Education Resource

· Maintain and demonstrate thorough and up-to-date knowledge of disease state, study methodology, clinical information, and product data

· Demonstrate full knowledge of and ability to execute on approved medical platforms/strategies and MSL initiatives

· Serve as technical/scientific subject matter resource to Eisai cross functional partners

· Teach, coach and mentor new or less experienced MSLs; assist with supervision/performance evaluation; assume responsibility for special projects. Provide valuable contributions to the organization including leadership and strategic planning.


Research Support

· Facilitate review and follow up of submitted Investigator-Initiated Studies (IISs) and assist with Eisai sponsored trials.

· The MSL may also be involved with providing recommendations for site selection and scientific expertise to Investigators involved in company sponsored studies.


Qualifications:

Educational Requirements:

  • Advanced terminal D degree in medical or health sciences or related field (e.g MD/DO, PhD, PharmD)


Experience:

  • MSL experience in neurology or complex disease states preferred; prior dementia or AD research experience strongly preferred, 3 yrs+ required for Sr MSL title
  • Established relationships with KOLs in neurology, and knowledge of institutions focused on AD preferred
  • 2 plus years industry/ clinical research/ related experience in a scientific or clinical setting
  • Strong broad-based scientific and pharmaceutical knowledge
  • Clinical trial development and drug launch experience is preferred
  • Knowledge of treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, FDA regulations, pharma regulations/compliant practices, and OIG guidelines are required

Other:

  • Interested and skilled in communicating complex data sets and the ability to be seen as a scientific peer while educating top KOLs
  • Committed to the concept of team and working within the framework of Medical Affairs
  • Strong overall written and verbal communication skills. Keen understanding of your audience and ability to tailor information appropriately
  • Highly skilled in the art of strategic conversation along with a demonstrated ability to assess issues, as they arise and adapt appropriately
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate, organize, plan and handle multiple priorities, while adapting to the needs of the company and KOLs
  • Has an ability to work independently and not require close supervision while adhering to compliance/regulatory policies
  • Interest in leading and participating in projects while effectively balancing field work
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify opportunities/challenges, willingness to communicate these challenges to leadership while working together to overcome them
  • Seamlessly adapts to field situations and effectively problem solves within territory
  • Experience working in matrix environment including cross-functional commercial partners, with an understanding of the pharmaceutical corporate environment and appreciation for Commercial Operations, including Marketing and Sales strategies
  • Sound computer/technology skills including applications for word processing, producing slide materials, working with spreadsheets, and video conferencing.
  • Possesses and maintains a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Capable of engaging in frequent business travel (approximately 60% of time), including air travel, ability to travel overnight and occasionally on weekends
  • This is a field-based position. The employee is required to set up a home-based office within their defined territory

title: Enrollment Coach II or Senior Enrollment Coach
description:
Job Title: Enrollment Coach II and Senior Enrollment Coach

Department: Enrollment Management Services

Location: Remote

Reports to: EMS Manager

(Salary range: $24.52 - $28.85/hr)


Who You Are

The Senior Enrollment Coach is responsible for all aspects of the student recruitment process for client institutions. The programs we represent span the higher education vertical, from undergraduate to graduate, online and on-campus. The Senior Enrollment Coach is the direct point of contact for prospective students on all questions related to client programs, application processes, and enrollment information and manages student engagement including providing retention services, post-start, when applicable.


For some accounts, the Senior Enrollment Coach may be responsible for student support that goes beyond the point of new enrollment, including continued registration throughout a degree program. In these scenarios, the Senior Enrollment Coach is responsible for product knowledge regarding continuing registration, course options and selection, and managing a total student enrollment portfolio.


Here are the abilities that we seek out:

  • Manage a large database of prospective student inquiries, handling 100+ calls per day at times
  • Engage in conversations with a variety of individuals daily, focusing on identifying their interests and highlighting relevant features of the program they are interested in.
  • Provide detailed and accurate program information to ensure the prospective student is positioned to make a fully informed decision in instances where the prospect is a strong match for the client program
  • Manage all aspects of the recruitment pipeline for the accounts you are assigned to including interviewing prospective students and managing the enrollment process
  • Assist in document collection including previous transcripts, resumes, letters of reference, etc.
  • Discuss program information with highly informed prospective students thoroughly
  • Work independently, but be able to collaborate with management and clients to create and execute effective enrollment processes and strategies
  • Interact directly with clients, face-to-face, via phone, and email
  • Update all interactions in a CRM to ensure a high level of prospective student service
  • Manage paperwork, pay extreme attention to detail, and provide accurate updates to account leads and management as needed
  • Maintain compliance in all areas of the role including when communicating program details and documenting student interactions
  • Follow up with enrolled students to ensure timely registration for upcoming terms and accurate total enrollment counts by program portfolio
  • Participate in the training and development of EMS colleagues


Who We Are


EducationDynamics

EducationDynamics is the transformative strategic partner that helps schools meet the challenges and opportunities of serving the Modern Learner. Our mission is to expand opportunity through education by helping colleges and universities understand, engage and serve all students. With services that include marketing, enrollment management, market research, inquiry generation, consulting and student retention, we have dedicated the last 35 years to helping schools prosper as the largest provider of unbundled enrollment growth services.

Advancing the way brands connect to people to build a better future. Our core values: Integrity, Resiliency, Accountability, Curiosity, and Collaboration.


The Project Manager works collaboratively with a variety of client teams to coordinate sensory and consumer research projects to ensure successful implementation and deliverables that meet industry and company standards.


Key responsibilities: manage the day-to-day tasks necessary to carry out the research project, coordinate and facilitate all research and operational activities, including oversight of recruiting, survey programming, procurement, creating project execution documents and holding briefing calls with cross functional teams.


Primary Responsibilities

Collaboration on study creation, execution and revision of customized project work plans and milestones as appropriate, to meet changing needs and requirements of client to ensure that each study is handled effectively, efficiently and to all client specifications:

  • Create project execution protocol instruction documents
  • Schedule and conduct all recruiting and execution briefings

  • Oversee fieldwork and data collection
  • Act as escalation contact for recruiting and fielding issues

  • Coordination of national/international study execution as needed
  • Assisting on departmental special projects as requested

  • Managing of day-to-day operational aspects of a project
  • Responsible for controllable on time, error free and on budget project fulfillment
  • QC of all internal project execution processes

  • Sensory experience on either client or supplier side
  • Food/Beverage, QSR, or HBA experience preferred
  • Quality-focused with attention to detail and accuracy

title: Senior Machine Learning R&D Engineer – Matterport
description:
Senior Machine Learning R&D Engineer – Matterport

<br>

Job Description

<br>

CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

About Matterport:

Matterport is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our groundbreaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 170 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing.

About the Role:

Matterport has captured one of the largest and most diverse repositories of real-world 3D spatial data in existence. We are building a team to turn that data into a foundational reconstruction model — a model that can reconstruct, complete, understand, and generate photorealistic 3D spaces from sparse, incomplete, or noisy captures.

As a Senior Machine Learning R&D Engineer on this team, you will research and build the next generation of neural reconstruction and generative systems that power Matterport's digital twins. Rather than reconstructing only what the camera saw, our goal is to generatively complete spaces — filling occlusions, synthesizing unseen views, upgrading capture fidelity, and ultimately generating entire coherent 3D environments. You will work at the intersection of neural rendering, novel view synthesis, and generative modeling, training large-scale models on Matterport's proprietary data to solve problems that no existing dataset or model can address.

This is a hands-on research-and-engineering role for someone who wants to push the state of the art in 3D generative AI and ship it into a product used across 170+ countries. You will collaborate closely with fellow researchers, platform engineers, and product teams to translate frontier ideas into capabilities our customers can feel.

Responsibilities:

  • Research, design, and train large-scale foundational models for 3D reconstruction and generative scene completion, leveraging Matterport's proprietary corpus of real-world spatial data.
  • Advance the state of the art in neural rendering (e.g., Gaussian splatting, NeRFs, feed-forward/large reconstruction models) and novel view synthesis for real-world indoor and outdoor spaces.
  • Develop generative approaches — including diffusion models and video/3D generation — to complete occluded or missing regions, synthesize unobserved viewpoints, and enhance the realism and completeness of digital twins.
  • Design, implement, and optimize scalable training and inference pipelines for large 3D and multi-view datasets, including images, video, point clouds, and meshes.
  • Translate research prototypes into production-ready systems, partnering with engineering teams to integrate models into Matterport's core capture and reconstruction platform.
  • Define rigorous evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for reconstruction quality, view synthesis fidelity, and generative plausibility; drive iterative improvements against them.
  • Stay current with advances across neural rendering, generative modeling, and 3D vision, and proactively identify opportunities to apply new techniques to Matterport's challenges.
  • Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and researchers to scope projects, assess technical feasibility, and deliver high-impact features.
  • Contribute to the architectural design and strategic roadmap of Matterport's foundational reconstruction model and broader ML research initiatives.
  • Contribute to Matterport's intellectual property through patents and publications and represent our work to the broader research community.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited, not-for-profit, in-person University or College
  • A track record of commitment to prior employers.
  • Experience in machine learning research and development, with a strong focus on computer vision, 3D data processing, neural rendering, or generative modeling.
  • Proficiency in PyTorch and strong programming skills in Python.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including deep learning architectures (e.g., CNNs, Transformers, diffusion models), optimization techniques, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas).
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research, propose novel solutions, and implement them effectively.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex, real-world datasets.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Graphics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied ML research and development, particularly training and shipping large models to production.
  • Demonstrated expertise in building or training foundation / large-scale models and/or depth in two or more of the following:
    • Neural rendering & novel view synthesis — Gaussian splatting, NeRFs, large/feed-forward reconstruction models, differentiable rendering.
    • Generative modeling — diffusion models, image/video generation, 3D generation, world models.
    • 3D computer vision — 3D reconstruction, SLAM/structure-from-motion, multi-view geometry, point cloud and mesh processing, depth estimation.
  • Experience with large-scale model training infrastructure — distributed/multi-GPU training, large-dataset curation and pipelines, and scaling to large model and data sizes.
  • Strong track record of publications at top-tier venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, SIGGRAPH) or significant open-source contributions.
  • Ability to use AI tools to accelerate work.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical projects.
  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to a diverse audience.

What's in it for you?

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.

We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement.

  • Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to):
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug
  • Life, legal, and supplementary insurance
  • Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family
  • Commuter and parking benefits
  • 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions

  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Onsite fitness center and/or reimbursed fitness center membership costs (location dependent)
  • Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups
  • Complimentary gourmet coffee, tea, hot chocolate, fresh fruit, and other healthy snacks

title: Mgr-Infection Control
description:
Mgr-Infection Control

7200 Infection Control

About the Position

The Infection Control Manager manages and administers the hospital's Infection Control Program in conjunction with the Infection Prevention Council. The department oversees all policies and procedures related to infection control. In accordance with the hospital's mission and the goals of the Infection Prevention Council, the Infection Control Manager designs system-wide surveillance of infectious processes to prevent acquisition or transmission of illness. The Infection Control Manager is responsible to lead the organization in the recognition and reduction of transmitted diseases to realize excellence (90th percentile performance) in infection rates across the healthcare system. The manager must be able to work collaboratively with a wide range of people including Medical Staff, other clinical staff, departments of the healthcare system and outside organizations. The Infection Control Manager establishes evidence-based practices and educational programs to ensure infection control is an ongoing, priority initiative throughout the healthcare system. In addition, the Infection Control Manager develops, recommends and works to implement both long- and short-term goals for the Infection Prevention Council. The Infection Control Manager will collate, analyze and disseminate surveillance information to the Infection Prevention Council and others within the organization as appropriate. In response to surveillance findings, the Infection Control Manager recommends and implements specific intervention measures to prevent infections. The Infection Control Manager works with specific departments to arrange for any follow-up and institute preventive measures when this is deemed necessary.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Leads and is responsible for system-wide infection control prevention program.
  • Assists with system-wide patient safety program, with a focus on hospital acquired infection prevention.
  • Participates on the daily Operational Call.
  • Familiar with all DNV, CMS, state, and other regulatory reporting requirements relating to Infection Control.
  • Demonstrate understanding of infection control policies regarding hospital acquired infections, ECRI, and antibiotic stewardship.
  • Demonstrate understanding of interdepartmental processes and workflow to support infection control and prevention.
  • Ensures timely data collection and submission to CMS and other agencies.
  • Serves as the site administrator for NHSN and ensures all data submissions are accurate, complete, and timely.
  • Continues education and remains familiar and knowledgeable of the various CMS rules and regulations regarding infection control.
  • Oversees continuous DNV survey readiness for infection control.
  • Assists the Quality Director with performance excellence projects, as defined in the organizational strategic framework.
  • Serves as a representative on the system wide safety and patient safety committees.
  • Co-chairs the Infection Prevention Council.
  • Responsible for maintenance of employee schedules and timecards for department,
    ensures timecards are completed timely on payroll Monday.
  • Sets and communicates clear performance expectations of team members and monitors by direct observation.
  • Responsible to complete probationary and annual evaluations.
  • Responsible to complete corrective action for employees as appropriate.
  • Participates in professional education programs as appropriate for professional and personal development.
  • Serves as an educational consultant as requested.
  • Designs and conducts meaningful surveillance programs in accordance with the objective of the Infection Prevention Council.
  • Statistically analyzes and prepares nosocomial surveillance reports for the Infection Prevention Council, Quality Committee, Medical Staff Committees, and other appropriate committees.
  • In response to surveillance findings, will work with appropriate persons to design and implement appropriate preventive strategies. In the absence of surveillance data confirming a problem, will work with appropriate persons to analyze situations and develop needed corrective actions.
  • Coordinates and ensures timely completion and compliance with rounding
    throughout Reid’s Organization.
  • Participates in general hospital orientation and regular in-service training to update personnel with current infection control guidelines, policies, and procedures.
  • Develops and implements programs to ensure compliance with current regulations and recommendations of IOSHA, DNV, ISDH, CDC, and other regulatory agencies as well as the hospital's insurance carrier.
  • Participates and communicates with infection control personnel in other hospitals and healthcare facilities within APIC Indiana and Ohio Chapters.
  • The Infection Control Manager assigns tasks to the Infection Control Practitioner including, but not limited to rounding, in the moment education, and auditing.

Education and Experience
Education Required:

  • Minimum of bachelor’s degree in health-related field or five (5) years of relevant experience in health-related field. Registered Nurse preferred.

Education Preferred:

  • Certification or eligibility for certification in infection control by the Certification Board of Infection Control and in Epidemiology, Inc.

Experience Required:

  • At least five years’ experience in a hospital or clinical setting which includes experience in quality assessment and improvement. Must be able to work in the suite of Microsoft office products—Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Must have a working knowledge of computer equipment and software packages defined for standard use. Must be able to run electronic reports from clinical databases and evaluate the data for effective use in assessing quality.
  • Must be able to manage change needed in a fast-paced environment. Strength in organizational skills and attention to detail. Must be an effective communicator.

title: Senior Director I, AP Life Science Generalist, Curriculum and Assessment
description:
Senior Director I, AP Life Science Generalist, Curriculum and Assessment

College Board – AP and Instruction

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Science department, which includes biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, environmental science, anatomy and physiology, and Research, is currently made up of 21 people supporting 10 courses in the AP portfolio.

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Director I, AP Life Science Generalist, Curriculum and Assessment you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration across multiple course titles; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review, providing leadership and modeling for course experts across multiple course titles. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Science/Life Science teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP Science/Life Science, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP Science/Life Science across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.

In this role, you will:

Assessment Development and Scoring (40-50%)

  • Serve as an assessment leader for AP Science/Life Science, with primary responsibility for assessment development and final assessment (items and forms) approval for AP Science/Life Science. Your work will vary from year to year, with accountability across multiple test titles, requiring assessment and content domain expertise across multiple subject areas. You will be accountable for developing and reviewing content, and providing final program sign-off on test forms. You will be assigned work based upon needs that vary year to year, which means you will be accountable for seamlessly moving in and out of assessment workstreams across subjects, leveraging your expertise about assessment, assessment processes, and content domain expertise. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that typically requires no adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders.

  • Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents. Leverage generative AI (as appropriate for subject/discipline) to author and/or review assessment content to improve and/or make more efficient assessment processes and outputs.

  • Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP Science/Life Science through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP Science/Life Science Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate.

  • Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP Science/Life Science, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications.

  • Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Science/Life Science Test Development Committees. You independently strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits.

  • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Science/Life Science as content development contributors and reviewers.

  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP Science/Life Science Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You independently plan all-year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.

Assessment Quality and Process (25-30%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions

  • Provide functional leadership of cross-subject assessment workstreams to ensure consistency and leverage efficiencies. Will serve as an expert resource for course team and leadership consultation.

  • Provide formal training and informal mentoring to other Course Experts within your AP Science/Life Science, based on need.

  • Develop strong efficiencies in item development through well-defined and well-documented task models, item development training and processes, and highly effective use of generative AI.

  • Independently lead (with limited managerial support) initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives including AI innovation and professional learning best practices that scale assessment to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP Biology and Environmental Science exams.

  • Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP Biology and Environmental Science exam. Identify areas for improvement and independently (with limited managerial support) lead and execute targeted initiatives to improve.

  • Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP Biology and Environmental Science exam.

Staff Development and Capacity Building (25-30%)

  • Train and support course experts in assessment development practices, including quality, validity, fairness, and use of generative AI, deepening their understanding of the item and test development lifecycle, and effective use of item authoring and item bank platforms.

  • Mentor team members in effectively facilitating test development committees and working with external stakeholders.

Course Development and Program Support (0-10%)

  • Refine and improve AP Science/Life Science Course Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.

  • Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP Biology and Environmental Science designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams.

About You

You (have):

  • A Master’s degree in Biology, Environmental Science, or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred

  • Expertise in Biology or Environmental Science with at least 10 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred

  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset

  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading

  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation

  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback

  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

description:

Patient Relations/Services

40

Summary:

The Manager of Patient Relations works under the direction of the Director of Patient Relations and is responsible for all patient relations efforts. Serves as a neutral liaison between patients/families and Cook Children’s Healthcare caregivers. The Manager is responsible for assuring compliance with the regulatory requirements involving patient rights, complaints, and grievances established by hospital/system policies as well as external auditing agencies, including The Joint Commission (TJC), the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Service (CMS), The Texas Department of Health (TDH), and state and federal law. Responsible for maintaining appropriate focus on the department’s regulatory responsibilities in each phase of the department work flow. Maintains familiarity with changes and updates to the relevant laws and mandates set forth by TDH, CMS and TJC. Responsible for conferring with Legal and Administration as needed to keep internal regulatory policies up to date. Monitors internal practices to ensure the Medical Center remains in compliance with both auditing agency requirements and state and federal laws. Provides strategic direction and oversight for efforts to improve service recovery in all clinical areas. Employees in the Office of Patient Relations report directly to the Manager.

Patient Relations Manager Qualifications:

1. Minimum Bachelor’s degree. Masters preferred in Science, Human Relations, Business, Healthcare Administration and or Communications or related field

2. Minimum of three years healthcare experience, preferably in an acute care setting and in lieu of extensive customer service/patient relations experience

3. Two+ years of experience with working with patient grievances and complaints required

4. Experience with organizing and leading crucial family meetings with hospital leadership that pertain to a complaint or grievance preferred

5. Preferred demonstrated leadership experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills required.

  • Excellent communication, critical thinking and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated ability to work as part of multiple teams.

  • Ability to prioritize and address a variety of patient/family issues with firm timeframes. Be able to demonstrate organizational, problem-solving and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to think in a proactive and creative manner. Willingness to take initiative in appropriate manner.

  • Bilingual language abilities and skills preferred.

  • Stamina and energy to maintain direct patient and family contact on a regular basis, and to coordinate multiple demands made on time.

  • Ability to relate to diverse age and demographic backgrounds.

  • Sound understanding of concepts of family-centered care.

  • Strong data analytics – ability to analyze and synthesize complaint/grievance data; use data to identify and address themes and trend; provide guidance on areas of improvement.

  • Ability to form and maintain strong working relationships with other hospital stakeholders to aide process of complaint identification and resolution.

  • Outstanding organizational skills leveraging technology to store, track, retrieve data.

  • Mediation Skills

  • Coaching and Mentoring Skills

  • Proficient in use of PC with experience in Excel, Work and database management packages.

  • Proficient in collecting, documenting and resolving patient/families issues in the appropriate timeframe.

  • Knowledge of CMS, Joint Commission, TDH and other regulatory agency guidelines.

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Web Developer to join K3 Advisory Group on a permanent basis, as part of the team building our new web platform. This role is aligned to our Kuala Lumpur office on a hybrid workstyle.

K3's web estate — our principal group site, brand sites, and marketing microsites — is moving from WordPress to a headless CMS (Contentful) and integrating into Salesforce and our group data platform.

You’ll join at the point this platform is being built, working across both front-end and back-end layers, and reporting into our Principal Web Developer, who sets the technical standards and architecture you’ll be building to.

This is a role built for continuity: you’ll be the person who carries the platform’s institutional knowledge forward well beyond the initial build, working closely with our Front-End Web Developer, UX Designer, and Technical SEO Managers to deliver an agreed set of builds, integrations and roadmap items over the long term.

This role suits an experienced, self-sufficient developer comfortable picking up a new CMS platform fast, working to standards set by someone else and staying close enough to the detail to mentor others through peak delivery periods.

  • Front End - HTML5, JS, CSS3, React, Next.js.
  • Back End - PHP, Node, Python, REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, Salesforce and data-platform integration touchpoints; AWS, Azure, CDN.
  • Content Platform - Contentful — Content Management API, GraphQL Content API, webhooks, environments.

COMMERCIAL OBJECTIVES

  • Delivery of the agreed platform build scope on time and to specification.
  • Continuity of technical delivery across the platform’s lifecycle.
  • Domain authority, page ranking, site health & CVR across owned deliverables.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Management

  • Development release schedule & QA delivery, working to standards set by the Principal Web Developer.
  • Mentors and reviews work from contract-hire developers brought in during peak migration periods.

Functional Responsibilities

  • Full-stack codebase development on Contentful: landing pages, components, content-model-driven templates, front-end/back-end and API integrations.
  • Delivery of new website features, landing pages, microsites and conversion journeys set by Technical SEO, Performance, CRO and UX.
  • Contentful platform work: content model implementation, Content Management API scripting for migrations, webhook configuration for downstream sync.
  • MarTech & integration: form integrations, lead routing, API connections to Salesforce and the data platform, data validation, event tracking — built to the integration standards set by the Principal Web Developer.
  • Technical SEO enablement: structured data via the Contentful content model, canonicals, redirects, internal linking, sitemaps, robots.txt.
  • Tracking: tracking scripts, conversion events, pixel deployment, server-side tracking, consent management, coordinated with our suppression/preference centre build.
  • Executes secure coding practice and access controls to standards set and reviewed by the Principal Web Developer.
  • Backend & infrastructure: server-side logic, database management, API development, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure) and CDN configuration.

With over 1,200 employees across the Group, 25 offices in the UK, and international bases in Malaysia andCyprus

title: Scheduler
description:
Scheduler

PBF Energy Inc. (NYSE:PBF) is one of the largest independent refiners in North America, operating through its subsidiaries, oil refineries and related facilities. We are seeking a talented Scheduler to join our team as a pivotal member that would play a key role here at PBF Energy. This role would be located onsite at our Company headquarters in Parsippany, NJ.

The Scheduler will serve as the key liaison between Trading, Gulf and East Coast refineries, and external counterparties to ensure the seamless coordination and execution of all purchase and sale deliveries across multiple commodities. This role supports the movement of Crude and Feedstocks, Clean Products, and LPGs through various modes of transportation, including—but not limited to—pipeline, terminal, barge, vessel, rail, and truck. Due to the operational demands of this role, the Scheduler must be available to support business needs on a 24/7 on‑call basis.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Schedule movements of Crude, Feedstocks, Clean Products, and LPGs via pipelines, terminals, barges, vessels, rail, and truck for the Gulf and East Coast region.

  • Coordinate all logistics associated with commodity movements to ensure timely and accurate execution.

  • Manage supply/demand balances, asset inventories, and daily logistical operations to support Trading strategies and refinery requirements.

  • Serve as a primary communication point with Traders, refineries, counterparties, pipeline operators, and other operational stakeholders.

  • Maintain strong internal and external relationships, ensuring consistent, clear communication.

  • Oversee multiple simultaneous operational activities, maintaining strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Monitor and resolve scheduling or delivery issues, ensuring uninterrupted flow of commodities.

  • Interpret, understand, and apply terms of Oil contracts, including logistics requirements, quantity/quality provisions, and commercial obligations.

  • Support inventory reconciliation, settlements, and other administrative and accounting processes; assist in resolving discrepancies or adjustments.

  • Accrue, verify, and reconcile secondary and operational costs associated with commodity movements.

  • Review and approve vendor and supplier invoices in accordance with contractual terms.

  • Input and maintain timely, accurate data within the ETRM system.

  • Execute additional related duties and ad‑hoc requests as needed.

  • Availability to support business needs on a 24/7 on‑call basis is required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered.

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or scheduling—preferably within the oil or energy sector.

  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical abilities, with the capability to anticipate issues and engage appropriate stakeholders to resolve them.

  • Demonstrated ability to make sound, timely decisions in a fast‑paced operational environment.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective, collaborative working relationships.

  • Proven ability to perform well under pressure and manage competing priorities.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience interacting with both internal and external customers.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with crude oil, refined products, LPGs, or other commodity logistics.

  • Exposure to a dynamic trading environment with cross‑functional collaboration.

  • Familiarity with ETRM systems; experience with RightAngle preferred.

  • This position is on site 5 days a week.

  • ONLY CANDIDATES MEETING THE ABOVE REQUIREMENTS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

  • FOR SERIOUS CONSIDERATION, PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR SALARY REQUIREMENTS.

title: Auditor de Calidad
description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

We are a sustainable company engaged to the values of Excellence, Innovation, Collaboration, Respect and Responsibility. We seek professionals who share our vision of creating sustainable solutions that improve lives and protect the planet, today and for future generations.

We are looking for your talent, join our team and start your journey today!

  • Calificar y dar seguimiento a no conformidades detectadas durante Auditoria de Proceso hasta su cierre.
  • Escalar problemas de calidad en caso de que no se dé una solución efectiva por parte del responsable del área siguiendo el plan de escalamiento.
  • Apoyar en aclaración de criterios de aceptación – rechazos relacionados al aseguramiento de Calidad al personal operativo.
  • Realizar reportes de Rechazo cuando se encuentre una No-Conformidad o cualquier discrepancia con las especificaciones.
  • Dar seguimiento a las boletas de rechazo hasta su cumplimiento o terminación.
  • Validar el scrap según Procedimiento de Control de Scrap
  • Dar apoyo para el desarrollo de nuevos productos, ejecución de primeros artículos y liberación de primeras muestras incluyendo reportes dimensionales para el envío a nuestros clientes para su respectiva validación.
  • Ingresar datos y reportes en base de datos
  • Capturar y analizar la información registrada en Datalyzer según aplique de acuerdo con el proyecto.
  • Dar seguimiento a puntos fuera de control y/o especificación en gráficos de control hasta su cierre con acciones correctivas y/o preventivas
  • Mantener 5S en las áreas a cargo

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

title: Senior Data Engineer L2 Or Manager (Gcp + Snowflake)
description:
About MPS Group

At MPS Group, we empower businesses with cutting-edge technology solutions and expert consulting. We proudly serve a diverse range of industries, including IT, Fintech, Airlines, Energy, and more. Our expertise spans front-end technologies (React, Angular, Vue.js), back-end technologies (Java, .NET, Node.js, Python), and comprehensive Data Solutions (Database, Data Warehousing, BI, Reporting, Analytics). Our services include custom software development, QA Testing (SDET), Automation Testing, IT staffing, business development consulting, and DevOps services. We adopt both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, offering flexibility through onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models. From cloud solutions (Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP) to digital advisory and project management, we craft innovative, tailored strategies designed to meet your specific business goals and drive long-term success.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands‑on experience designing, building, and maintaining modern data platforms using Snowflake and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role will focus on data migration, data integration, and data product enablement initiatives, helping organizations build scalable, governed, and well‑documented data ecosystems. The ideal candidate combines solid data engineering expertise with a strong understanding of data modelling, metadata management, and data product documentation. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and metadata-driven architectures is highly valued. Documentation and ownership of data assets are key aspects of this role.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines and ingestion frameworks using Snowflake and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Lead and support data migration initiatives between enterprise data platforms, including Snowflake‑based environments.
  • Build, optimize, and maintain data models that support analytics, reporting, and data product consumption.
  • Develop and manage metadata‑driven solutions, ensuring data assets are discoverable, governed, and reusable.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance YAML‑based configurations, metadata definitions, and deployment artifacts.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Produce high‑quality technical documentation for data products, pipelines, operational processes, and platform capabilities.
  • Support CI/CD and infrastructure automation practices, leveraging Infrastructure as Code principles where applicable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related data platform roles.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with Snowflake in production environments.
  • Experience building data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Composer, or equivalent GCP services).
  • Proven experience delivering data migration or modernization projects involving Snowflake and cloud‑based data platforms.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modelling, data warehousing, and data modelling best practices.
  • Experience working with metadata management, data cataloging, and data governance concepts.
  • Proficiency in SQL and one or more programming languages such as Python.

- Own incident management, including on-call leadership, incident response, and blameless postmortems.

title: Mechanical Pre-Commissioning Technician 1
description:
As a Mechanical Pre-Commissioning Technician 1 presents a valuable opportunity to contribute to the delivery of high-quality mechanical systems. This role is vital in ensuring the seamless preparation of our systems for commissioning, suited for individuals with hands-on mechanical expertise and a strong commitment to safety and quality.

We offer:

What We Offer:

  • Career Development
  • Competitive Compensation and Benefits
  • Pay Transparency
  • Global Opportunities

Learn More Here:


Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $44,000 - $65,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Tasks and Qualifications:

Responsibilities of this Position:

  • Formulate and keep up an Action Item List (punch list) for monitoring and resolving issues.
  • Confirm all components are accurately installed per the system's drawings, ensuring accuracy and precision.
  • Verify units are positioned at the accurate elevation and installed straight and level.
  • Ensure supports and hangers are plumb and securely fastened.
  • Check for any loose or missing hardware to maintain system integrity.
  • Confirm that the belt path and tension are correct and supervised accurately.
  • Learn accurate product tracking methods to improve system efficiency.
  • Complete all items from the model-specific checklist with attention to detail.
  • Learn how to confirm build speeds of all units, ensuring they meet specifications.
  • Perform low-volume tests using a range of carton sizes to check for dead zones, catch points, and product/edge tracking issues.
  • Install, run-in, and fix equipment, ensuring it operates flawlessly.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a willingness to take direction to foster a collaborative work environment.
  • Consistency in attendance and punctuality for all scheduled workdays.
  • A safety-conscious approach to ensure a safe working environment for all team members.
  • Demonstrating the capability to work autonomously and collaboratively, ensuring project timelines are adhered to and deadlines are met.
  • Flexibility to work in different climates and environments, adapting to various job site conditions.
  • Physical stamina to walk, crawl, and climb for extended periods.
  • Willingness to travel 100% for work anywhere in the U.S. for extended durations.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting prints to ensure accurate installations.
  • Capability to perform detailed model-specific static and multifaceted checks of mechanical components.
  • Skill in applying and filling out model-specific checklists to uphold detailed documentation.
  • Skill to produce and sustain an action item catalog from inspections.
  • Basic problem-solving skills to address and resolve technical issues.

Join us at Dematic Corp. and be part of a team that is dedicated to successfully implementing outstanding mechanical systems. Your contributions will be valued as we aim to compete at the highest levels of engineering excellence. This is an exceptional opportunity to grow your career and be part of something truly exciting!

  • Minimum of four (4) years of relevant industry experience, OR A post‑secondary degree or diploma

  • Completed the core proficiency components for IR licensing, including: Canadian Securities Course (CSC) Conduct & Practices Handbook Course (CPH) or Canadian Investment Regulatory Exam (CIRE)

  • Familiarity with common wealth management strategies and their relative strengths and weaknesses

  • Excellent communication, time management, and listening skills

  • Strong verbal and written languages skills in both French and in English preferred.

Salaried
