title: AVEVA PI Implementation - Data Migration Engineer
description:
Jora Malaysia will close on 9th September 2026. Thank you for being with us, we are cheering you on as you continue your career journey.

AVEVA PI Implementation - Data Migration Engineer

We are seeking an experienced AVEVA/OSIsoft PI Engineer for a project involving the construction of a new PI environment and the migration of configuration and historical data from an existing system.

The engineer will review the extracted data, construct the required PI database and structures, load the historical information, and validate the completed environment.

This role requires practical experience in PI database construction and data migration, rather than only routine PI administration or user support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review extracted PI tag lists, metadata, configuration and historical-data files.
  • Assess the completeness and quality of the extracted information.
  • Develop the PI database build and data-migration plan.
  • Create and configure PI Data Archive points/tags in bulk.
  • Reconstruct PI Asset Framework databases, hierarchies, templates and attributes.
  • Map source tags and metadata to the new PI environment.
  • Import historical data while preserving timestamps and data-quality indicators.
  • Identify missing tags, duplicate records, data gaps and configuration inconsistencies.
  • Configure or support PI Interfaces, PI Connectors, OPC connections and PI Buffer Subsystems.
  • Recreate or migrate PI Vision displays, where required.
  • Validate and reconcile the migrated data against the source information.
  • Conduct migration testing and support user acceptance.Produce migration records, test results and as-built documentation.
  • Provide technical handover and knowledge transfer to the support team.

Key Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with AVEVA PI System or OSIsoft PI System.
  • Experience building or substantially rebuilding a PI Data Archive database.
  • Experience creating and configuring PI points/tags in bulk.
  • Experience migrating PI configuration or historical data into a new environment.
  • Working knowledge of PI Data Archive, PI Asset Framework, PI System Management Tools and PI Builder.
  • Ability to validate migrated data and identify data-quality issues.
  • Good troubleshooting and technical-documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate with technical and business users.

Advantageous Experience

  • PI Vision, PI Interfaces, PI Connectors or PI Buffer Subsystem.
  • Working with large tag populations or high-volume time-series datasets.
  • Data science, data engineering or industrial-data analytics.
  • Python, SQL, Power BI or similar data-analysis tools.
  • Statistical analysis, anomaly detection or data-quality assessment.
  • Experience with DCS, PLC, SCADA or OPC-connected systems.

Applicants should provide details of at least one project in which they personally built, rebuilt or migrated a PI database.

Further project and client details will be provided to shortlisted candidates, subject to applicable confidentiality requirements

title: STIVA Assembly Supplier Quality Technician
description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Role Overview

This role is responsible for assisting with production-related and inspection-related tasks in a manufacturing environment. You will monitor material quality, support containment and corrective action activities, and help improve supplier performance so that daily operations run smoothly and long-term quality expectations are maintained.

What will you do?

  • Support incoming inspection and production areas by identifying, documenting, and escalating supplier-related quality issues.
  • Lead or assist with containment actions for nonconforming materials to protect production continuity.
  • Track and follow up on NCRs, open quality issues, and supplier corrective action responses.
  • Work with suppliers to drive root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, and effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support APQP, PPAP, and engineering change activities related to supplier quality readiness.
  • Maintain accurate quality records, status updates, and communication logs in the required systems.
  • Partner with engineers, procurement, production, and quality teams to resolve issues and improve material quality performance.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying recurring problems and supporting updates to inspection or control methods.

How will you do it?

  • You will stay close to the work by responding quickly to supplier quality concerns, verifying the impact on incoming materials and production, and escalating issues with clear facts.
  • You will use disciplined problem-solving to support root cause analysis, corrective actions, and follow-up until issues are contained and closed.
  • You will work as one team with suppliers, engineers, procurement, and operations, sharing information openly and helping remove obstacles that affect quality or delivery.
  • You will improve every day by identifying trends, strengthening inspection approaches, and helping enhance existing methods to support safer, more stable, and more sustainable operations.

What are we looking for?

  • University degree and 1 year of suggested minimum experience, or a 2-year degree and 6 years of suggested minimum experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience in supplier quality, quality control, incoming inspection, manufacturing quality, or a related production support environment.
  • Knowledge of quality tools and methods such as NCRs, 8D, containment actions, root cause analysis, APQP, PPAP, and ECNs.
  • Ability to read and interpret specifications, inspection criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication, follow-up, and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and support daily operational needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality tracking or documentation systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using PLEX, IRIS, SharePoint, or similar quality and tracking systems.
  • Background in automotive, assembly, or high-volume manufacturing environments.
  • Familiarity with ISO-based quality systems and supplier performance reporting such as PPM tracking.

What do we offer?

  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Supportive and inclusive work environment.
  • Commitment to work-life balance and employee well-being.
  • Engagement in meaningful projects that make a difference.

description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

We are a dynamic team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. You will share in the team’s impact on all aspects of New Glenn product development and mission integration. In this role you will integrate the configuration and interfaces between the launch vehicle and the assembly, transportation, launch pad, and recovery operations.

title: Software Asset & License Analyst III
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Software Asset & License Analyst III is the deepest technical and commercial expert on duty in a single shift. One of these roles sits on each of the three IST-anchored windows, and the seat exists so that every hour of the 24x5 clock has someone who can resolve a floating-licence server failure, construct a defensible licence position, and judge a high-risk agreement without waiting for the next window to open. Level I is measured on throughput, Level II on transactional judgment; Level III is measured on depth — the problems that reach this seat are the ones nobody below it can close.

The seat is expert-track with no supervisory remit: rota, work allocation, performance management and shift command all sit with the Software Asset & CLH Analyst IV who leads the same shift. What the Level III owns instead is technical authority: Corporate License Hosting server operations and daemon recovery, Initial and Final Licence Position construction, EULA and clickwrap gating on high-risk requests, publisher and reseller escalation, and the design of the automation that takes repeat work off the queue. The analyst is the technical escalation point the shift lead calls on, and the standard-setter whose method the Level II and Level I analysts are trained against.

CORE COMPETENCIES & EXPERTISE

  • Corporate License Hosting — hands-on operation of floating and concurrent licence servers: FlexNet and comparable daemons, licence file structure and safe editing, daemon and service recovery, and concurrent checkout and peak-usage analysis through the Altair Floating License Monitor.
  • Licensing models — working command of perpetual, subscription, SaaS, concurrent/floating and consumable-credit models, and of what each one does to compliance exposure, true-up mechanics and renewal leverage.
  • Licence position & audit evidence — building Initial and Final Licence Positions by reconciling entitlement against deployment and consumption evidence, and defending the result to a publisher or an internal auditor.
  • Commercial & legal gating — reading EULAs and clickwrap terms for the risk they carry, recognising the use cases that must be stopped rather than processed, and holding the signature-authority boundary without exception.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Corporate License Hosting — Server & Daemon Operations

  • Monitor the health of the global licence servers hosting concurrent and floating licences on the shift, working daemon drops and service failures to resolution inside the 4-hour critical SLA.
  • Raise and validate 'Licence File Change' requests on contract renewal, quantity change or expiry, editing the flat text configuration files on the hosting servers correctly and reversibly.
  • Read concurrent checkout and peak-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor — logging in strictly as a guest, and never entering corporate credentials without explicit system-administrator approval.
  • Assess new hosting requests against the CLH eligibility criteria — native floating or concurrent licence support, Windows or Linux server compatibility, a supported daemon (FlexNet preferred), no geolocation or policy usage restrictions, and an active catalogue item carrying user instructions.
  • Apply the CLH request-routing matrix on unlisted floating-licence requests: check the hosted-titles list, broker spare capacity with the product champion on shared pools, bypass pool sharing on private pools, and capture destination MAC addresses where a requester declines hosting.
  • Manage decommissioning: raise the support request to retire the daemon and remove licence files from the server when a hosted product is withdrawn.

2. Licence Position, Renewals & Consumption Analysis

  • Act as the technical owner of licence position on the shift — compiling the Initial Licence Position at the 180-day milestone and the Final Licence Position at 60 days, from usage scans, deployment data and SaaS consumption snapshots.
  • Ensure harvested and reclaimed licences are pruned from the baseline before the Final Licence Position is set, so no shelfware is carried into a renewal.
  • Resolve the entitlement and edition questions Level II cannot close — overlapping entitlements, downgrade and second-use rights, bundling and suite coverage, and consumable-credit burn-down.
  • Model true-up exposure against contracted baselines and identify which commercial route applies — an amendment where a signature alters contracted quantities, a purchase-order addition where no signature is required.
  • Validate the accuracy of Deal Radar contract and event records for the renewals in flight on the shift, correcting event typing, recurrence numbering and metadata errors at source rather than downstream.
  • Quantify and evidence savings and cost avoidance in the licence-reclaim audit table, to a standard that survives finance review.

3. High-Risk Gating — EULA, Clickwrap, Legal & Authority Controls

  • Own high-risk EULA and clickwrap review on the shift: copy non-signed agreements to secure storage and check the master reviews register to confirm whether an approved review already exists within the last three years before triggering a new one.
  • Enforce the signed-agreement prohibition — signed agreements are never accepted through the standard unlisted queue and must be routed via the contract intake path to be managed as formal legal cases.
  • Identify and reject out-of-scope use cases on sight — code to be incorporated into customer-facing products, personal-device use, and reverse engineering — using the standard responses and correct onward routing.
  • Coordinate vendor security assessments and legal-review pipelines, and track cases needing director-level signature through to execution by the client's own signatory. No member of the team signs or e-signs anything.
  • Hold the sensitive-data controls: licence keys, audit notifications and accessibility information move to the private queue on identification, without exception.

4. Publisher Escalation, Audit Defence, Automation & Technical Standards

  • Own the technical escalation path into publishers and resellers for entitlement, key and activation failures the shift cannot resolve, and drive them to closure rather than handing them on.
  • Assemble entitlement, deployment and proof-of-purchase evidence for publisher audits and Semi-Annual Business Reviews, and reconcile discrepancies before they escalate into findings.
  • Identify automation candidates and author Business Requirements Documents where a publisher crosses 1,000 transactions a year, moving work onto robotic process automation or vendor APIs.
  • Configure and audit automated reclamation campaigns in gHive / UiPath, and investigate the failures and false positives the automation produces.
  • Set and maintain the technical standard on the shift: author and refresh SOPs for CLH and licence-position procedures, and coach Level II and Level I analysts on method and casework quality — technical guidance only, with no line authority.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS

Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.

  • CLH Critical Response: resolve or contain critical Corporate License Hosting issues — daemon drops, server unavailability, checkout failures — within the 4-hour SLA.
  • Technical Escalation Closure: close escalations routed to the expert seat within the shift window, or hand them over with a documented diagnosis and next action.
  • Licence Position Accuracy: Initial and Final Licence Positions delivered on the milestone dates and fully reconcilable to usage evidence.
  • Legal & Authority Compliance: zero signed agreements processed through the unlisted queue; zero agreements signed by the team; 100% register check before a new legal review is raised.
  • Savings Integrity: reclamation and cost-avoidance entries complete, evidenced and accurate enough to stand as the savings record.
  • Automation Contribution: at least one automation or SOP improvement delivered per quarter against the shift's highest-volume repeat work.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

  • CLH & Licence Servers: global floating-licence servers, FlexNet and other supported daemons, flat text licence configuration files, and the Altair Floating License Monitor.
  • Entitlement & Usage: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking, plus usage scans and SaaS consumption snapshots for licence-position work.
  • Contract & Legal: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review pipelines, NDA requests and signature validation.
  • Queue & Automation: Ticketing and issue tracking systems for ticket and bug management with strict category coding, and gHive / UiPath for automated reclamation.
  • Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three-way matching.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Mandatory

  • 6–10+ years in software asset management or software licensing operations, with a track record as a senior technical escalation point rather than a queue processor.
  • Hands-on Corporate License Hosting or floating-licence server experience: FlexNet or comparable daemons, editing licence configuration files, troubleshooting daemon and service drops, and reading concurrent-usage metrics.
  • Proven licence-position work — reconciling entitlement against deployed and consumed usage, and defending the result to a publisher or auditor.
  • Strong command of EULA and clickwrap review, licence terms and the commercial and legal risk they carry, with the judgment to stop a request rather than pass it through.
  • Comfortable working a fixed or rotating non-standard shift, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
  • Clear English communication and the confidence to hold a technical or compliance line with client stakeholders, publishers and resellers.

Preferred

  • Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential).
  • Linux and Windows server administration exposure sufficient to work licence-server issues alongside infrastructure teams.
  • Scripting or automation literacy (Python, Apps Script, UiPath) for reclamation, reporting and BRD authoring.
  • Experience supporting publisher business reviews, audit responses or negotiation preparation.

title: Systems Engineer, Thermal Hardware - Lunar Permanence
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As a key member of the Lunar Core Components Heat Transfer team, you will be applying your skills to provide thermal hardware expertise to our Lunar vehicle architectures.

In this role you will contribute to a team of Thermal Engineers simultaneously developing groundbreaking thermal hardware for lunar landers and driving those designs through build, test, and verification. We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Special Mentions:

  • Travel expected up to 20% of the time
  • Relocation provided

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Define and decompose Vehicle Thermal and Other subsystem-level requirements into actionable specifications within the Core Thermal-Fluids Heat transfer component domain to ensure our hardware meets vehicle needs.
  • Develop and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) with vehicle/s to ensure subsystem compatibility and integration fidelity.
  • Ownership of heat transfer component artifacts such as specifications, safety products, and other documents.
  • Conduct trade studies and make/buy decisions to determine hardware selection or optimization.
  • Drive verification and validation planning, including environmental testing, functional checks, and mission simulations.
  • Participate in hardware design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and ensure technical artifacts meet quality and compliance standards.
  • Support integration, test, and launch operations with hardware design team, including anomaly resolution and post-launch analysis as required.
  • Support schedule management of hardware engineering efforts and products, team coordination, and support make vs buy decisions, hardware procurement, and vendor management
  • Identify process improvements, generate new ideas, and foster a culture of technical excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ensuring alignment and synchronization of component analysis data with Vehicle system teams and interfacing subsystems such as Electrical Power, Liquids, Gas and GNC as required.
  • Reviewing system level & thermal subsystem level CONOPS information and distilling into useable datasets for consumption by the thermal hardware teams
  • Verifying compliance of hardware designs against documented requirements (such as temperature limits, AT/QT effort and so on)
  • Facilitate hardware risk, FMECA and FTA discussions with relevant stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum of a B.S. degree in engineering
  • 3+ years of related experience.
  • Knowledge of systems engineering best practices, integration processes, design for manufacturing, and quality control
  • Demonstrated experience in requirement analysis, interface definition, and component and system-level verification and validation.
  • Demonstrated experience with flight integration and environmental qualification (thermal, vibration, etc.).
  • Understanding of subsystems and their thermal implications across the mission lifecycle.
  • Background in active thermal control hardware or, thermal analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with spacecraft thermal control hardware design and development
  • Ability to perform simple thermal assessments via first principles/hand calculations
  • Experience with software tools such as DOORS, Jama, MATLAB, Cameo, Thermal Desktop etc. design and analysis tools.
  • Demonstrated experience working interface control
  • Demonstrated experience with requirements relaxation and challenging requirements to facilitate hardware development cycle.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S. degree in engineering
  • 5+ years of related experience.
  • Strong communication skills, with an ability to quickly build consensus among stakeholders.
  • Experience in space programs from concept through launch and operations.
  • Hands-on experience with satellite ground systems and mission operations.
  • Experience with data analysis (Matlab, Excel, Winplot, etc.), and scripting (bash, sh, Python, etc.) tools
  • Experience evaluating make/buy decisions
  • Expertise in active thermal control hardware, with a proven track record of flight hardware delivery
  • Experience with sub-assembly and/or system level thermal balance tests and post-test design correlation and validation

title: Associate Photographer - Birmingham, AL
description:
Associate Photographer - Birmingham, AL

<br>

Job Description

<br>

OVERVIEW

CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

The Role

Associate Photographers are the talented and versatile team responsible for the media collection for Homes.com and Apartments.com. Equipped with a top-of-the-line Pro 3 Matterport, digital camera equipment and iPad, our Associate Photographers create virtual tours, floorplans and photography for residential homes. Each Associate Photographer is given a core territory in which they are responsible for servicing clients of Homes.com and Apartments.com.

Associate Photographers will have appointments set for defined dates and times, where they will scan homes and apartments with Matterport Pro3 cameras, capturing virtual tours and floor plans. Associate Photographers will also be responsible for residential photography to be used in marketing purposes to advertise homes and apartments to future owners and renters. This role works closely with clients, sales associates, logistics and the management team. Photographers are managed remotely by a Photography Manager located in local markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Support marketing efforts on our industry-leading marketplaces, Homes.com and Apartments.com, by capturing beautiful 3-D virtual tours and footprints.

  • Create a portfolio of photographs to best feature homes and apartments, utilizing photography techniques to capture the spaces in the most pleasing way possible.

  • Work closely with scheduling and dispatch teams to maximize appointments and meet our client’s demands.

  • Professionally communicate with clients, sales, researcher partners, and management to strategically evaluate priorities, initiatives, and tasks.

  • Own the market! While not working on a residential home, navigate one-mile square grids to ensure complete commercial real estate data coverage. Identify new inventory, missing availability, and commercial properties to be photographed.

  • Abide by CoStar safety standards to safeguard company vehicle and equipment.

  • Represent CoStar in a professional manner at all times.

  • Participate in conference calls with sales and research teams as needed.

Physical Requirements of Position

  • Repetitive and frequent sitting in a car, standing and walking for up to 8 hours per day.

  • Must lift, carry, and maneuver equipment weighing up to 5 pounds

  • Repetitive hand and arm movements are needed to type on a tablet or laptop and operate camera equipment.

  • Occasional bending, stooping, squatting, lifting, twisting, and carrying are necessary to perform job functions.

  • Ability to work and drive outside during all seasons.

  • The ability to work weekends on a rotating schedule.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of professional experience.

  • Real Estate Photography experience required.

  • Track record of commitment to previous employers.

  • Experience working as a professional photographer, or a recently earned degree in photography.

  • High School Diploma/GED

  • Strong customer service experience with a client first mindset.

  • Be an experienced Drone Photographer with a FAA Part 107 License/Certification obtained within 30 days of offer.

  • Strong time management skills and very detailed oriented.

  • Capability to accurately capture and enter data.

  • Excellent communication (oral and written) and organizational skills.

  • Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft Office, and Internet applications. Additionally, Apple IOS products.

  • Enjoys working independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Field experience preferred.

  • Candidates must possess a current and valid driver’s license.

  • Satisfactory completion of a Driving Record/Driving Abstract check prior to start. Driving history must reflect responsible driving behavior and compliance with traffic laws.

Compensation:

The Associate Photographer position is hourly plus bonus-eligible position. The bonuses are paid on a monthly cycle and are based on your performance against pre-determined performance metrics. We are seeking individuals who thrive in a metrics and performance-based environment and who are driven by bonus incentives to produce great results.

This is an hourly role. The pay amounts to $50,000 annually, with opportunity for monthly bonuses.

What's In It For You?

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.

We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement.

Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to):

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug

  • Life, legal, and supplementary insurance

  • Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family

  • 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions

  • Employee stock purchase plan

  • Paid time off

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups

We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing

title: Director, Project Management - Domain Delivery Lead
description:
Director, Project Management - Domain Delivery Lead

At Capital One, we’re building a leading information-based technology company. Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams.

Role Specific:

The Bank Tech Technical Program Management and Delivery organization is seeking a highly organized and self-motivated Director of Project Management to join the Delivery team. In this role, you will have unique visibility into and influence over Bank Tech’s most strategic and complex initiatives, impacting multiple lines of business.

The Domain Delivery Lead (DDL) is the strategic linchpin of our Domain-Centric Organization. Operating in a federated model, DDLs advance the development, maintenance, and overall health of our reusable technology solutions (platforms and services). In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to Engineering Accountable Executives (AEs) to propel our technology towers toward the destination state of our SaaS journey.

Unlike a Technical Program Manager (TPM) aligned to prioritized programs, the DDL is allocated long-term to a specific Tech tower and portfolio of systems / applications. They are dedicated to supporting the AE in their development and execution of their Tower’s strategy, including evolving delivery practices, governing current delivery standards, and strategically leveraging data and dashboards to enhance Tower Health. The DDL ensures broad visibility of achievements and centralizes risk/impediment tracking for the steady-state portfolio of work, inclusive and in collaboration with TPMs and Project Managers leading specific initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic, well-rounded candidate to boldly model the future of technical delivery excellence.

A successful DDL possesses a robust background in technology strategy and consulting. If you are a strategist who understands how to bridge the gap between complex technical architectures and overarching business objectives, this role is tailored for you. You should be adept at evaluating software assets, partnering with engineers on solution-oriented architectures, driving platform maturity, and leading enterprise-wide tech transformations.

What you’ll do:

1. Lead Domain Reviews & Tech Strategy

  • Drive monthly, tower-centric reviews of asset architecture and outcomes to inform leadership on the Domain’s SaaS journey.

  • Provide a recurring steering moment to promote alignment of strategic priorities across partnering towers.

  • Synthesize complex technical data (asset maps, current state vs. destination architecture, platform health) into actionable insights to drive executive decision-making.

2. Drive Local Intent & Asset Development

  • Oversee the asset inventory for the tower, defining the strategy and vision for platform development.

  • Partner with engineering leaders to categorize assets (invest, maintain, deprecate) and compile comprehensive solution roadmaps.

  • Determine the intersection of initiatives required to progress the domain’s technical roadmap, mapping key milestones against available capacity.

3. Promote Tower Operations & Health Monitoring

  • Utilize health and productivity dashboards natively (e.g., tracking availability, latency, incident tracking/MTTR, and velocity) to drive data-driven continuous improvement.

  • Support localized tower rhythms, including identifying architectural bottlenecks, reviewing financial health for proper investment allocation, and streamlining planning routines.

  • Coach sub-organizations to ensure adherence to SaaS frameworks, metrics standards, and data integrity.

Who you are:

  • Technology Strategy Expertise: Proven background in technology strategy, IT consulting, or enterprise architecture.

  • SaaS & Product Mindset: Deep understanding of SaaS operating models, platform development, asset-centric delivery, and cloud-native architectures.

  • Executive Presence & Storytelling: Exceptional ability to craft compelling narratives, lead executive-level Domain Reviews, and influence senior stakeholders and Accountable Executives.

  • Holistic Portfolio Management: Demonstrated ability to look beyond day-to-day project execution to manage overarching domain capacity, identify convergence opportunities, and mitigate cross-initiative risks.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: High proficiency in leveraging analytics and platform health metrics to optimize operations and guide technical investments.

  • Can work autonomously and knows when to escalate in a timely manner with direct manager and leadership

  • Confident to champion unpopular ideas even with more senior leaders

  • Ability to navigate ambiguous situations

  • Collaborative, team player attitude with the ability to navigate and influence the organization

  • Executive communication skills that can tell the story that will positively drive transformational change

  • Contributor to continuous improvement of program / portfolio management practices

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • At least 9 years of technical program management or project management experience

  • At least 3 years of technology strategy experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Masters in Business Administration or Computer Science

  • 10+ years of process, project, or program management experience

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

title: Senior MuleSoft Integration Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Senior MuleSoft Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain API-based integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems. You will play a key role in enabling seamless data flow across our technology landscape and supporting our digital transformation initiatives.

What will you do?:

  • Java Development & Microservices – Develop and maintain Java applications and microservices; build custom connectors and extensions; implement object-oriented design patterns and best practices; optimize performance and memory management
  • CI/CD & DevOps – Oversee CI/CD pipeline implementation and optimization; manage deployments on OpenShift; configure artifact repository management (Artifactory); automate build and deployment processes
  • Code Quality & Testing – Conduct code reviews; implement MUnit testing frameworks; establish quality standards; ensure security scanning and compliance across Java and MuleSoft applications
  • API & Integration Management – Manage API lifecycle and governance through API management platforms; troubleshoot complex integration and Java-related issues; optimize data mappings and transformations
  • Database & Performance Optimization – Design and manage database architecture for integration solutions; optimize SQL queries; manage data performance and system efficiency
  • Automation & Support – Develop Python scripts for automation and integration support tasks; manage data transformations and integrations across systems
  • Technical Leadership & Mentoring – Mentor development teams on Java and integration best practices; foster code quality culture; promote technical excellence and knowledge sharing

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

Must have:

  • 5+ years of MuleSoft development experience
  • 5+ years of Java programming and development experience
  • Strong understanding of Java frameworks and libraries
  • Proficiency with REST APIs and API management
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and OpenShift
  • Knowledge of Artifactory, MUnit testing, and code scanning tools
  • Salesforce integration experience
  • Database design and SQL knowledge
  • Python scripting capabilities

Nice-to-have:

  • MuleSoft and Oracle/Java certification
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Spring Framework expertise
  • Agile/Scrum methodology experience

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

  • A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
  • Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Business Systems Analyst plans and directs analysis of complex business problems to be solved with automated systems. This entails working closely with business partners, developers, testers, scrum leads, product owners, data teams and project managers to develop software specifications, perform impact analysis, monitor the progress of software development and validate subsequent software meets requirements. Mentors and collaborates with technical and non-technical team members, leading the requirements gathering and analysis process independently. The Senior Business Analyst should be able to lead analysis of 1-2 projects and multiple products independently.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Elicit, analyze and document business and system requirements with strong skills in requirements decomposition (epics → features → user stories → acceptance criteria).

  • Responsible for communicating changes that have a downstream impact to systems/modules managed by other teams to ensure awareness and alignment around any changes and the criticality/priority of the changes.

  • Independently facilitate stakeholder alignment across business and IT.

  • Facilitate and/or participate in workshops, discovery sessions, and stakeholder interviews.

  • Consult with business to identify and document business needs and objectives, current operational procedures, problems, input and output requirements, data scope, usage, formatting, and security requirements.

  • Document and analyze nonfunctional requirements for the systems, ensuring they comply with HIPAA, state regulations, and data privacy standards.

  • Must have ability to do process mapping, data analysis, wireframing and prototyping to assist in design phase of software development.

  • Experience with Agile delivery models, backlog management and prioritization

  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications. Write and maintain functional specifications for new or modified business systems by consulting with the developers, data engineers and IT management. Has ultimate responsibility for the specifications document.

  • Be able to solicit acceptance criteria in partnership with Product owners

  • Drive and collaborate with testing teams to validate business and functional process and outcomes

  • Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure requirements are met.

  • Accountable to ensure traceability from requirements through delivery.

  • Monitor and document post-implementation problems and revision requests.

  • Assist with user training and related documentation as needed to ensure smooth adoption of changes/enhancements.

  • Support evolving business needs, as applicable.

Education, Experience, Competencies & Values

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year College or university; and three to five plus years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience within professional and/or commercial insurance industry, preferred.

  • Strong understanding of underwriting workflows, risk assessment and policy lifecycle, preferred.

  • Experience working with externally facing applications to ensure proper coordination with Legal, Security and Corporate Communications before changes are rolled out, preferred.

  • Broad knowledge and understanding of SharePoint and Microsoft Suite.

  • Broad knowledge with SDLC methodologies.

  • Experience working with automated testing tools, quality assurance best practices and SQL queries.

  • Excellent analytical and problem resolution skills.

  • Strong attention to detail, process, deadlines and quality results.

  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Ability to interact with a wide variety of clients, both internal and external.

  • Self-motivated to develop unique approaches to special projects.

  • Commitment to continuous education with ability and willingness to transfer knowledge.

  • Occasional overnight travel may be required of this position. (10% or less.)

Base salary range is $90,475 - $122,405. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

title: Beverage Cart Attendant
description:
Position Summary

The Beverage Cart Attendant is responsible for providing friendly, efficient snack and beverage service to golfers throughout our 9-hole par 3 short course. The attendant operates a mobile golf cart stocked with beverages, snacks, and other approved items,

providing convenient service to golfers while they enjoy their round. Because our facility features a relaxed 9-hole short course, this position plays an important role in creating a fun, welcoming, and hospitable atmosphere for golfers of all ages and skill levels.

This is a hands-on, guest-facing position that requires excellent customer service, attention to detail, responsible cash and payment handling, and the ability to safely operate a golf cart while working independently outdoors.


What We’re Looking For

The ideal Snack & Beverage Cart Attendant is someone who enjoys working outdoors, interacting with guests, and providing great hospitality. This person should be comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and actively engaging golfers rather

than waiting for guests to request service. We are looking for a team member who is friendly, energetic, dependable, sales-

minded, and attentive to detail. The attendant should take pride in keeping the cart clean and well stocked, handling transactions accurately, and providing quick and convenient service throughout the course. Above all, the Snack & Beverage Cart Attendant should help create a friendly, fun, and welcoming golf experience by making it easy for golfers to enjoy snacks and drinks

during their round on our 9-hole par 3 short course.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Snack & Beverage Cart Operations

  • Prepare the snack and beverage cart for daily service, ensuring it is clean, organized, fully stocked, and in proper operating condition.
  • Stock beverages, snacks, ice, cups, napkins, condiments, and other supplies according to established par levels.
  • Maintain an attractive, clean, and organized product display throughout the shift.
  • Monitor inventory and restock the cart as needed.
  • Maintain proper temperatures for beverages and any food items requiring temperature control.
  • Follow all food handling, sanitation, and food safety procedures.
  • Return the cart to the designated area at the end of the shift and complete all cleaning, restocking, and closing procedures.
  • Report mechanical, operational, inventory, or safety concerns to managemen promptly.

Guest Service & Sales

  • Provide a warm, welcoming, and attentive experience for golfers and guests.
  • Clearly communicate available snack and beverage offerings and pricing.
  • Take guest orders accurately and provide prompt service.
  • Process cash, credit card, and other approved forms of payment using the designated point-of-sale system.
  • Maintain accurate transactions and properly account for cash and inventory during the shift.
  • Suggest additional items when appropriate while maintaining a friendly, service-focused approach.
  • Respond promptly to reasonable guest requests and refer questions or concerns to management when necessary.
  • Provide the same professional and courteous service to beginners, juniors, families, experienced golfers, and event participants.
  • Help create a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere that complements the short-course golf experience.

Alcoholic Beverage Service

  • Serve alcoholic beverages only in accordance with company policies and all applicable state and local laws.
  • Verify identification and legal drinking age when required.
  • Follow responsible alcohol service procedures at all times.
  • Refuse or discontinue alcohol service when required by law or company policy and immediately involve management when appropriate.
  • Maintain control and accountability of alcoholic beverage inventory throughout the shift.


Qualifications

  • Previous food and beverage, hospitality, golf course, retail, or customer service eperience is preferred but not required.
  • Previous cash-handling or point-of-sale experience is helpful.
  • Friendly, dependable, outgoing, and professional demeanor.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Comfortable approaching guests and making food and beverage sales.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing as part of a team.
  • Ability to accurately handle cash, credit card transactions, and basic sales calculations.
  • Ability to follow food safety, sanitation, alcohol service, and workplace safety procedures.
  • Basic knowledge of golf and golf course etiquette is helpful but not required.
  • Must be punctual and reliable.
  • Must meet all applicable age requirements for serving alcoholic beverages.
  • Required alcohol service or food safety certifications must be obtained and maintained when applicable.
  • Valid driver’s license may be required depending on company policy.


Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to frequently bend, reach, push, pull, lift, and perform repetitive stocking and cleaning tasks.

High School Diploma and two (2) years post High School related experience working with youth or (2) years working in a security field or providing direct patient care. Any equivalent combination of related education and/or experience may be considered for the above requirements.

title: AI Data & Database Engineer – Modernization & AI Infrastructure
description:
WEX is looking for a Senior AI Data & Database Engineer to help modernize critical SQL Server systems while building the data infrastructure that powers AI applications and agents. This is a hands-on engineering role spanning database modernization, performance engineering, data pipelines, and AI-native retrieval infrastructure.

You’ll work across two highly connected areas: modernizing complex legacy database systems by extracting business logic, improving performance, and enabling event-driven architectures; and building AI-ready data capabilities including embedding pipelines, vector search, RAG infrastructure, and retrieval services.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving hard data problems and is excited to use AI as an engineering accelerator. You’ll use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code to analyze legacy code, generate and validate migration scripts, troubleshoot performance issues, and automate database engineering workflows.

What You'll Do

Database Modernization & Performance

  • Analyze complex SQL Server stored procedures and identify embedded business logic, dependencies, and data access patterns.

  • Refactor stored procedures using established architectural patterns to simplify data access, improve maintainability, and enable business logic to move into services.

  • Design and execute database migrations while maintaining data integrity, availability, and backward compatibility.

  • Analyze execution plans, optimize queries, and design effective indexing strategies for high-volume workloads.

  • Implement event-driven database patterns including CDC, outbox patterns, and event publishing.

  • Build automated tests and validation processes for database changes, migrations, and refactored procedures.

  • Create structured, AI-consumable documentation including annotated schemas, procedures, dependencies, and system context.

AI-Native Data Infrastructure

  • Build embedding pipelines covering text extraction, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, and vector storage.

  • Implement and optimize vector databases, vector indexes, semantic search, and hybrid retrieval patterns.

  • Build synchronization pipelines that keep vector stores aligned with source systems.

  • Develop retrieval APIs and services consumed by AI applications and agents.

  • Implement evaluation and monitoring for RAG systems, including retrieval quality, latency, relevance, and data freshness.

  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to improve embedding strategies, retrieval quality, and overall AI data performance.

Data Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement reliable ETL/ELT pipelines across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and cloud data services.

  • Build API-based ingestion, event streaming, and batch-processing workflows.

  • Implement data quality, validation, observability, and operational monitoring for data pipelines.

  • Develop infrastructure-as-code for database provisioning and configuration using Terraform and ARM/Bicep.

  • Support NoSQL data solutions including MongoDB and Cosmos DB, with a focus on data modeling and query performance.

  • Design data access patterns that support domain-driven architectures, including repositories, query services, and read models.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI coding assistants daily to accelerate database analysis, code generation, debugging, testing, and documentation.

  • Develop prompts, scripts, and workflows that apply AI to database engineering and modernization challenges.

  • Contribute to AI-powered engineering tools such as stored procedure analyzers, schema documentation generators, and migration assistants.

  • Create structured context and artifacts that enable AI agents and coding tools to reason effectively about data systems.

  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and identify practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity.

Collaboration & Engineering Excellence

  • Partner with application, platform, and AI/ML engineers to design scalable, reliable data solutions.

  • Participate in code and architecture reviews for database, data platform, and AI infrastructure changes.

  • Troubleshoot complex production data and performance issues and contribute to operational support as needed.

  • Document technical decisions, patterns, and solutions so knowledge is reusable across engineering teams.

  • Mentor engineers on database design, performance optimization, data engineering, and modern engineering practices.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, query optimization, and execution plans.

  • Proven experience modernizing legacy database systems and decomposing complex database logic into maintainable application or service architectures.

  • Strong understanding of relational database design, indexing, transactions, data integrity, and performance engineering.

  • Experience building production-grade data pipelines and integrating data through APIs, events, and batch processes.

  • Experience with one or more modern data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB.

  • Practical experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, RAG, or AI data pipelines.

  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and patterns such as CDC and transactional outbox.

  • Experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure-as-code, preferably AWS/Azure and Terraform.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and code review practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI coding assistants effectively and willingness to incorporate AI into day-to-day engineering work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data infrastructure specifically for LLM or agentic applications.

  • Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, pgvector, or similar technologies.

  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms.

  • Experience developing retrieval services or RAG evaluation frameworks.

  • Experience creating internal AI-powered developer tools or automation.

  • Experience working in large-scale, distributed, cloud-native environments.

How You'll Make an Impact

You’ll play a key role in transforming how WEX manages and uses data—from modernizing foundational SQL Server systems to building the retrieval and data infrastructure required for the next generation of AI applications. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys deep technical problem-solving and wants to work at the intersection of database engineering, modernization, and AI infrastructure.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. title: Senior Ecotoxicologist
location: USA - Texas - Houston - The Woodlands - Corporate Office
description:
Job Description:

Senior Ecotoxicologist

Huntsman is seeking a Senior Ecotoxicologist supporting the Global EHS Division across locations. Remote work is an option. This position will report to the Toxicology Team Manager.

Job Scope

  • The senior ecotoxicologist provides expert advice to all Huntsman businesses, by the application of professional judgment in ecotoxicology, exposure sciences and regulatory compliance.
  • The candidate is responsible for supporting the development and registration of Huntsman products, using hazard and exposure data to conduct environmental risk assessments, support evaluation and authorization processes and to ensure the regulatory compliance of Huntsman products.
  • The candidate should have a strong background in environmental science including environmental risk assessment, environmental chemistry, ecotoxicology, analytical chemistry, as well as proven track record of teamwork capability. Laboratory experiences on biodegradation and ecotoxicity testing are preferred.
  • The candidate will design environmental testing and assessment strategies with the aim to minimize animal testing without risking the environmental or human health safety profile of products.
  • Given the role supports a global team and all regions, semi-frequent travel will be necessary.

The Senior Ecotoxicologist will operate with minimal supervision. Their core responsibilities are as follows:

  • Along with colleagues from the toxicology team, support the three Huntsman divisions with environmental hazard and risk assessment expertise in all stages of product development (R&D of new chemicals/products and/or new markets and uses). This requires the candidate to understand the requirements set forth by the authorities in the different regions (TSCA, REACH, Canada, Korea, China) and collaborate with regulatory specialists to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Study monitor external ecotoxicological/ environmental fate studies, ensuring choice of laboratory is undertaken according to internal and external guidelines.
  • Use of in silico tools (QSAR and read across) for screening, prioritization and where appropriate, regulatory endpoint data submission.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to prepare dossier submissions in IUCLID or other formats. Includes application of read-across approaches for environmental fate and ecotoxicity endpoint data requirements.
  • Technical lead for ecotoxicology related issue management or substance defense. Steer advocacy strategies with regulatory bodies and active participation in discussions with global authorities across the Huntsman portfolio.
  • Maintain technical expertise in areas of ecotoxicology and risk assessment. Keep abreast of relevant regulations, legislation and emerging issues related to environmental hazard. Communicate impact to relevant Huntsman divisions.
  • Ensure ecotoxicological, environmental fate & physical-chemical data used for the classification of Huntsman products are scientifically evaluated, are up-to -date and maintained in the appropriate Huntsman databases and systems. Proactively communicate changes to stakeholders to ensure full understandings and business implications.
  • Represent Huntsman in various industry consortia and trade associations. Be an active participant in all meetings. Advise and convey relevant information to stakeholders which could influence or impact Huntsman operations.

Qualifications

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.


The candidate must have an unrestricted right to work for Huntsman in the United States if applying for the role in the Americas

Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced Degree (Master/ PhD) with 10 years of relevant professional experience preferably in an international company in the chemical or pharmaceutical sector, or at a Contract research organization.
  • Extensive applied experience in Regulatory ecotoxicology, risk assessment and defense of self-classification and labelling (GHS, CLP).
  • Knowledge of ecotoxicological and environmental fate methods and guidelines and well as use of in silico tools (QSARs) and read across.
  • Extensive experience with EU REACH, TSCA and Canada chemical registration.
  • Practical experience with relevant software tools such as OECD QSAR toolbox, IUCLID, CHESAR, easyTRA.
  • Experience with consortia and trade association work.
  • Fluency in English. Ability to work with colleagues globally in a multi-cultural environment and in a hybrid setting is essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing scientific teams, driving performance, collaboration, and results.
  • Professional certification as ecotoxicologist/ environmental scientist is a plus.
  • Practical experience with China and Korea chemical registration is a plus.
  • Previous environmental lab experience on environmental safety assays is desirable

Working Environment

  • Remote work is an option.
  • Up to 20% travel.

title: Corrugator Transfer Car Operator - (Overnight Sun-Thurs)
description:
Menasha Corporation Employees, please log-in to your Workday account to apply for positions.

ABOUT US (AND OUR EXCITING FUTURE)

Menasha Corporation is all about possibilities. Our two businesses, Menasha Packaging and ORBIS Corporation, are leaders in their industries, providing corrugated and plastic packaging products and related services to major global companies.

Our employees make the difference, proving that great ideas, collaboration and quality turn possibilities into success. Working at Menasha Corporation means that your insights provide cutting-edge solutions for our customers. If you like to make things happen and are passionate about what you do, you’re going to want to be here.

Join us and become part of the power behind possible.

About The Opportunity

The T-car Operator will be responsible to empty lines of corrugated stock from the dry end of the corrugator. They will organize the staging of unfinished corrugated and fill the conveyor lines for the flexo presses. Some pushing and heavy lifting of 60 lbs is required on a daily basis. A forklift license is required by all T-car Operators

Corrugator Department - Transfer Car Operator (Overnight Shift)

Shift: Sunday through Thursday, 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM - Overtime and extended shifts may be required, including 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM as needed to support production demands.

Pay: Training Rate: $27.82 per hour

Qualified Rate: $29.86 per hour

Position Summary: The T-Car Operator plays a critical role in supporting production operations by ensuring corrugated stock is efficiently moved, staged, and supplied to machine centers. This position is responsible for removing corrugated material from the dry end of the corrugator, organizing unfinished inventory, and maintaining a continuous flow of material to production equipment. The ideal candidate will be safety-focused, able to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and willing to work overtime when necessary.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Remove corrugated stock from the corrugator down-stacker lines and transport materials to designated staging areas.
  • Organize and stage unfinished corrugated materials to support efficient production flow.
  • Load and replenish conveyor lines with corrugated stock for flexo presses and other machine centers.
  • Monitor conveyor systems and material flow to ensure production equipment remains supplied with necessary materials.
  • Transport materials safely and efficiently throughout the facility using powered industrial equipment.
  • Maintain accurate inventory organization and proper stock rotation within staging areas.
  • Perform routine inspections of equipment and report any safety concerns, material issues, or equipment malfunctions.
  • Keep work areas clean, organized, and compliant with company safety standards.
  • Work closely with corrugator and machine center operators to support production schedules and minimize downtime.
  • Follow all company policies, safety procedures, quality standards, and work instructions.

Qualifications:

  • Must successfully complete training and become fully qualified as a T-Car Operator.
  • Forklift certification is required or ability to obtain and maintain forklift certification according to company standards.
  • Previous manufacturing, warehouse, or material handling experience preferred.
  • Ability to safely operate forklifts and other material handling equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Good communication skills and ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, and lifting throughout the shift.
  • Regular pushing, pulling, and moving of corrugated materials.
  • Ability to lift up to 60 pounds on a daily basis.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment that may include noise, dust, temperature fluctuations, and moving equipment.

Two companies, one vision.

Menasha Corporation consists of two companies that are leading the way to a sustainable future with packaging and supply chain solutions. Founded in 1849 and headquartered in Neenah, Wisconsin, we employ over 7,500 employees in 112 facilities in North America and Europe.

Our companies are leading corrugated and plastic packaging manufacturers and supply chain solution providers. Our Menasha Packaging Company is the largest independent provider of packaging and supply chain service solutions in North America, designing, printing, and fulfilling graphic packaging, display and merchandising solutions for over 1,800 brands, both in-store and online.


Our ORBIS business believes there is a better way to optimize today’s supply chains, with reusable packaging products and services. Reusable containers, pallets, dunnage, bulk systems and metal racks improve the flow product all along the supply chain to reduce costs, enhance profitability and add sustainability.


Our products and services are used by global, name-brand companies in the food, beverage, health and beauty, over-the-counter pharmaceutical, industrial, automotive, and electronics industries.

Come build an exciting, rewarding career with us, where you’ll have opportunities to grow.


The possibilities are endless. The power is yours!

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

Giving Back

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

Transamerica’s Parent Company

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. title: Auto Glass Technician Trainee
description:
Does this position interest you? You should apply – even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.

Does this position interest you? You should apply – even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.


A Brief Overview


A Technician Trainee will be trained and educated to become a proficient auto glass technician. Upon completing our training program, the trainee will receive the Safelite SafeTech certification and will possess fundamental skills necessary for performing unsupervised glass repair, replacement and recalibrations. The trainee is expected to embody the Safelite Spirit with a can-do attitude, caring heart and service mindset while striving to bring unexpected happiness to customers by completing jobs timely and with the highest quality standards.

What you will do


• Be paid to learn and apprentice the Safelite way, through hands-on and classroom training, including:
• Observing and assisting in installing and repairing auto glass
• Recalibrating automotive safety systems, including trouble-shooting and completing diagnostic testing
• Providing additional services & products
• Study and pass testing to become a Safelite-certified Technician showing proficiency in installations, embracing a positive attitude and following taught techniques.
• Safely operate company and customer vehicles, company-issued tools and chemicals utilized throughout the workday.
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Complies with all policies and standards

What you’ll get:


• Competitive weekly pay starting at $20.25/hour, increasing to $24.00/hour after training and certification.
• Earn additional income when customers choose value added products and services.
• A benefits package valued at more than $10k*. Includes 401(k) plan with company matching, medical plans, paid time off, holidays & volunteer days.
• Program to buy additional PTO or sell unused time up to 16 hours.
• Up to $5,250 annually in tuition reimbursement.
• Paid training and all the tools and resources you'll need to be successful.
• View all our health, wealth, and life offerings at www.safelitebenefits.com.

Education Qualifications


• High School Diploma GED/Equivalent Preferred

• Valid state-issued driver’s license any other license(s) (as required by federal, state and local laws) to operate a company vehicle. Required

Experience Qualifications


• Must be 18 years of age or older Required

Skills and Abilities


• Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 35 pounds and occasionally lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
• Ability to stand for extended periods, work in tight spaces, bend and twist body
• Ability to use a variety of hand tools and power tools safely and effectively
• Ability to operate a motor vehicle in accordance with all federal, state and local laws and agreement to be monitored via in-cab vehicle safety camera / video surveillance technology
• Maintains professionalism and passion for providing outstanding customer service and exceeding customer expectations
• Ability to safely work outside (in a wide variety of weather conditions and extreme temperatures) for extended periods
• Ability to work with chemicals (including but not limited to flammable chemicals), as applicable per the “Safelite Way of Fitting”
• Ability to work scheduled days, with flexibility on start and end times to accommodate customer’s needs
• Proficiency in using computerized diagnostic tools to complete recalibrations and trouble-shoot issues
• Problem-solving and ability to trouble-shoot issues, independently and collaboratively
• Ability to read, write and interpret the English language and technical directions
• Ability to communicate orally (via phone) and written (via computer or other electronic means)
• Ability to maintain a professional appearance, adhering to Company dress code and PPE policies
• Willingness and ability to maintain stable performance under professional or personal pressure and/or opposition (e.g., time pressure and productivity measures).

title: Data Architect / Engineer
description:
About us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

Technology is foundational to all of Appnovation’s offerings, from consulting to digital innovation, to digital product and service creation. The technology department is focused on delivering software solutions that enable rich consumer experiences, from mobile and web applications to advanced analytics and machine learning, to content and engagement management service enablement platforms.

Inherent throughout our tech capabilities is deep expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle, a drive for creativity, a passion for the craft, and collaboration with other disciplines - all foundational ingredients in successful digital experiences and client partnerships.

As a Data Architect / Engineer, you will join a highly motivated and experienced team and own both the data structures behind our graph-RAG platform and the pipelines that get content into it — modeling the knowledge and pumping it in at scale. You will define the schema, taxonomy and graph model for our knowledge domains, build resilient ingestion pipelines from enterprise content sources such as SharePoint and the wider Microsoft stack, and keep the knowledge graph accurate as source documents evolve. We are looking for people who can bring a strong, solution-focused mindset and contribute to architectural decisions, best practices and get things done.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define the schema, taxonomy, and graph modeling for the knowledge domains.
  • Design how documents, versions, and their machine-readable representations are structured, and how facts evolve over time (including temporal replay).
  • Build ingestion/ETL pipelines from enterprise content sources (e.g., SharePoint and the wider Microsoft stack), handling multimodal content (presentations, documents, transcripts).
  • Keep the knowledge graph in sync as source documents change frequently.
  • Advise on whether the current backend approach (Supabase/Postgres) is the right long-term architecture, and validate ingested content quality with QA.
  • Establish data quality, lineage, and governance standards across pipelines.
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and error-handling for ingestion jobs.
  • Document data models, schemas, and pipeline architecture.
  • Optimize pipeline cost, throughput, and reliability over time.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering / architecture roles.
  • Deep data modeling across relational and graph paradigms; graph databases (Neo4j) and Postgres/Supabase at scale.
  • Strong ETL / data pipeline engineering in Python, including large-scale, incremental, and change-data ingestion.
  • Experience with enterprise content ecosystems: SharePoint, ideally Power Platform / Power Automate.
  • Knowledge representation, taxonomies/ontologies, and versioned/temporal data.
  • Understanding of how data structures feed RAG and LLM retrieval quality.
  • SQL proficiency; experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and cloud data services.
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and privacy practices.
  • Strong documentation and cross-team communication skills.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You think about how to scale, automate and operate, not just how to build a solution to an immediate problem
  • You understand lean thinking
  • You set high standards for code quality, performance/scalability and security and seek continuous improvement
  • You have solid analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills
  • You have customer first mindset and a devotion to customer service
  • You engage and build positive internal and external client relationships, while managing multiple initiatives, often with competing priorities
  • You have strong self-initiative, passion, interpersonal, oral and written communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work, influence and make an impact in a cross-functional environment with all levels of the organization
  • You are responsive and thrive in a fast-paced diverse high-performance environment with rapidly changing business needs
  • You actively seek out things outside your comfort zone with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
  • You have prior experience in consulting
  • Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.
