Overview

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.

  • Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.

  • Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.

  • Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good.

  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.

  • You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.

  • You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.

  • You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 2 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies

  • At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)

  • Experience designing, developing, delivering, and supporting AI services

  • Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang

  • Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost

  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production

title: HRIS Integration Coordinator
description:
About SureCo

SureCo is a Healthcare Benefits Platform & Administrator on a mission to move the industry forward, so that everyone in America can access and afford high-quality healthcare. We do this by working in deeply invested partnerships across the ecosystem—with employers, employees, carriers, and technology companies—to build healthcare solutions that actually work for the people who rely on them. As we continue to grow, we are looking for dedicated professionals to join our team and contribute to our mission of driving positive change in the healthcare sector.


About the Role

The HRIS Integration Coordinator owns the end-to-end integration lifecycle for assigned customer accounts, serving as the primary technical point of contact for HRIS/payroll integration projects. This role combines deep technical expertise across multiple HRIS platforms with strong customer relationship management, leading complex integration implementations, managing ongoing data sync operations, and continuously improving integration processes and documentation.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Integration Ownership

  • Own the complete integration lifecycle for assigned customers from initial scoping through post-launch support
  • Lead integration scoping calls and technical discovery sessions with customer HRIS/payroll teams
  • Design and configure census and payroll data mappings based on customer requirements and benefits eligibility rules
  • Conduct integration testing, validation, and user acceptance testing with customers
  • Serve as primary escalation point for complex customer integration issues
  • Manage customer relationships and expectations throughout onboarding and ongoing support

Technical Implementation & API Management

  • Build and configure both assisted (file-based) and API-based integrations with multiple HRIS vendors
  • Lead Flexspring API integration rollouts, including testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Design custom data transformations and field-level mapping logic to meet unique customer needs
  • Implement and test advanced integration features (e.g., ignore/notify functionality, field-level overrides)
  • Troubleshoot complex data discrepancies, formatting issues, and integration failures
  • Collaborate with Engineering team on internal system enhancements, bug fixes, and platform improvements

Process Improvement & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive SOPs for HRIS integration processes
  • Build and expand the HRIS System Knowledge Hub with platform-specific best practices and quirks
  • Document system-specific nuances across HRIS platforms (ADP, Paychex, UKG, Paycom, Rippling, etc.)
  • Create testing protocols and validation checklists for new integration types
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and lead implementation of efficiency gains
  • Train and mentor junior HRIS team members on integration methodologies and tools

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Account Management team on customer onboarding timelines and expectations
  • Support Technical Implementation Specialists with complex eligibility and census questions
  • Collaborate with Engineering on design, integration architecture, and technical roadmap
  • Work to resolve urgent payroll and census processing issues
  • Participate in customer success initiatives & quarterly business reviews

Strategic Analysis & Reporting

  • Monitor integration health and performance metrics across customer portfolio
  • Conduct root cause analysis on recurring integration issues and implement preventive solutions
  • Track integration project status and maintain visibility into team workload and capacity
  • Report on integration trends, platform capabilities, and customer relationship health
  • Contribute to strategic decisions on integration tooling, partnerships, and team structure

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in HRIS integration, implementation, or administration roles with increasing responsibility
  • Deep expertise with multiple HRIS/payroll platforms (ADP, Paychex, UKG, Workday, Paycom, Rippling, BambooHR, etc.) and their API capabilities
  • Proven track record managing full-cycle HRIS integration projects from scoping through launch
  • Strong technical aptitude with APIs, data mapping, file formats (CSV, XML, JSON), and integration troubleshooting
  • Expert knowledge of benefits eligibility rules, census data requirements, and payroll data structures
  • Experience with customer-facing implementation projects, including scoping, requirements gathering, and change management
  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent integration projects
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for diagnosing complex data and integration issues
  • Outstanding communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences, both written and verbal
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to work independently and drive projects to completion

Work Arrangement and Compensation

  • This is a 100% remote position (aligned with US Pacific Time) with an annual salary of $100,000.
  • Numerous growth avenues exist, depending upon interests and skills - we know you’re unique, as is your career path, and we’ll work to support you on your journey.
  • Anticipated start date: week of September 28, 2026

title: Senior Lead Financial Engineer
description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

We are seeking a Senior Lead Financial Engineer to bridge the gap between our investment strategy business units and our software engineering teams. In this role, you will translate complex financial models into precise mathematical specifications and algorithms for our investment management proposal system. You will sit within the Investment Product Team, working daily inside an Agile development framework to build tools for portfolio optimization, risk assessment, and client wealth forecasting.

What will you do?

  • Algorithm Definition: Collaborate with business stakeholders to define, refine, and document quantitative algorithms for the investment proposal platform.

  • Mathematical Translation: Convert high-level financial models and concepts into rigorous mathematical formulas and technical specifications for software developers.

  • Core Model Support: Own the mathematical integrity of core system features, including portfolio optimization, Monte Carlo simulations, financial health scoring, and probability-based goal assessment models.

  • Agile Collaboration: Serve as the quantitative Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Scrum teams, participating in story writing, sprint planning, refinement, and code/math reviews.

  • Validation & Testing: Design and execute prototype models in Python or R to validate algorithmic accuracy before full-scale software production.

  • Product Strategy: Assist the Product Owner in prioritizing the quantitative roadmap based on business value and technical feasibility.

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in quantitative finance, financial engineering, or asset management role.

  • Education: Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Financial Engineering, Quantitative Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or a highly quantitative field.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of modern portfolio theory (MPT), multi-period asset allocation, stochastic processes, and statistical simulation techniques.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python, R, or MATLAB for prototyping and data analysis. Familiarity with SQL and version control (Git).

  • Software Delivery: Proven experience working alongside software engineers and translating financial math into clear, implementable developer specifications.

  • Methodology: Experience working within an Agile/Scrum development lifecycle.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate highly complex mathematical concepts to both non-technical business partners and software engineers.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building software components specifically for wealth management, robo-advisory, or retail investment proposal platforms.

  • Basic understanding of object-oriented programming (e.g., C#, Java, or C++) to help audit production code implementations.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients succeed and communities prosper. description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

As part of a small team, you’ll provide technical expertise and analytical solutions to support the development of new space vehicles and test/launch facilities. You’ll need proficiency in shock, vibration, and acoustic environment measurement/prediction/analysis, and related quantitative methods.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Prediction of launch vehicle vibration, shock, and acoustic environments due to engine, aerodynamic, pyrotechnic, or other sources, using empirical and numerical modeling methods.
  • Shock, vibration, and acoustic measurement/data processing and interpretation of ground and flight tests.
  • Development, supervision, troubleshooting, and verification/validation of component, sub-system, and system level dynamic environment tests.
  • Other high and low frequency loads tasks as required.
  • Payload/space vehicle mission integration and interaction with external Customers.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. degree in Mechanical or Aerospace engineering.
  • 8+ years of relevant engineering experience.
  • Passion for launch vehicle mission high frequency environments development/validation/testing.
  • Solid foundation of vibroacoustic and structural static/dynamic fundamentals, including PSD, Grms, SPL, OASPL, SRS, VRS, SDOF, FDS, static/dynamic equilibrium, stress/strain/modulus, etc.
  • MATLAB proficiency.
  • Experience with GitLab and Jira ITS.

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in launch and/or space vehicle vibroacoustic prediction/analysis/measurement/testing.
  • Python coding proficiency.
  • Experience with the following commercial numerical modeling software tools: Wave6, ANSYS, NASTRAN.
  • Development of web-accessible databases with API.

title: Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer
description:
Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer

Enthusiastic about securing cloud platforms and AI-driven solutions in a rapidly evolving technology landscape?
Do you enjoy designing security frameworks, enabling secure development practices, and partnering with engineering teams to build resilient, scalable, and compliant cloud and AI environments?

About the team:

LexisNexis Intellectual Property Solutions (LNIP) is the global leader in patent intelligence, bringing clarity to innovation for businesses, law firms, universities, and government agencies worldwide. Our mission is to help the innovation community make better decisions faster, with greater confidence, combining the world’s most trusted patent data with sophisticated analytics, AI-powered insights, and purpose-built workflows.

Protégé in PatentSight is LNIP’s next-generation agentic AI assistant, purpose-built for strategic patent analysis. Protégé replaces complex filter-based workflows with natural language questions, surfacing structured, decision-ready insights grounded in trusted data and established metrics.

About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer to provide hands-on cloud security engineering capability while also enabling the secure and effective use of AI across Information Security and product engineering teams.

This role sits between Security Architecture, BISO/Application Security, Cloud/Platform Engineering, and GRC. It is designed to reduce manual workload on Security Architecture and BISO/Application Security by turning recurring security requirements into reusable cloud guardrails, automated controls, AI-assisted workflows, secure design patterns, and developer-facing enablement materials.

The successful candidate will be a practical builder and security partner who can operate cloud security controls, support secure AI adoption, and use AI to improve the speed and consistency of security delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

Cloud Security Engineering

  • Build and maintain reusable cloud security guardrails for identity, logging, encryption, network segmentation, secrets management, storage, workloads, containers, serverless services, and data protection.

  • Translate security architecture standards into deployable cloud patterns, reference implementations, templates, and engineering-ready requirements.

  • Partner with cloud, platform, DevOps, and product engineering teams to embed security controls into cloud landing zones, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code workflows, and operational processes.

  • Support the implementation and tuning of CSPM, CNAPP, cloud workload protection, IaC scanning, secrets scanning, and related cloud security tooling.

  • Develop policy-as-code and control-as-code mechanisms to prevent, detect, and report common cloud misconfigurations.

  • Support cloud-native vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation by providing prioritization logic, remediation guidance, and reusable fix patterns.

  • Establish cloud security metrics and dashboards covering control adoption, misconfiguration trends, remediation progress, recurring issues, and exception patterns.

AI Security Enablement

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted workflows for security intake triage, threat model drafting, architecture review summaries, control mapping, remediation guidance, and risk statement generation.

  • Build prompt libraries, review rubrics, validation steps, and human-in-the-loop processes for approved AI use within Information Security.

  • Identify repetitive BISO, AppSec, and Security Architecture tasks that can be safely accelerated through AI-assisted processes.

  • Partner with GRC, Legal, Privacy, and security leadership to ensure AI-assisted security workflows are auditable, explainable, and aligned with internal risk expectations.

  • Measure the effectiveness of AI-assisted workflows, including time saved, consistency improvements, review quality, and reduction in repeat manual work.

Secure AI Application and Cloud-AI Guardrails

  • Define secure design patterns for AI-enabled applications, including LLM-based features, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, AI APIs, copilots, and automation workflows.

  • Establish cloud security requirements for AI workloads, including identity, secrets, data storage, network access, observability, workload isolation, and third-party AI service integrations in partnership with Sec Architecture & AppSec.

  • Support AI application threat modelling and risk reviews in partnership with BISO/AppSec.

  • Create developer-facing guidance for safe use of AI coding assistants, AI APIs, data ingestion, vector stores, model outputs, and AI-generated code in partnership with BISO/AppSec.

Security Enablement and Workload Reduction

  • Convert recurring BISO/AppSec and Security Architecture questions into reusable guidance, decision trees, approved patterns, checklists, and self-service workflows.

  • Build lightweight intake and routing mechanisms that help determine when a request needs BISO review, AppSec review, architecture review, GRC input, or engineering remediation.

  • Create and maintain a library of approved cloud and AI security patterns that product and engineering teams can reuse.

  • Help reduce one-off security consultations by embedding approved security decisions into tooling, templates, and standard delivery workflows.

Requirements:

Essential -

  • Experience in machine learning engineering. Strong experience in cloud security engineering, application security, security architecture, DevSecOps, or security automation.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS or Azure.

  • Practical knowledge of IAM, logging, encryption, secrets management, network security, storage security, vulnerability management, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and cloud security tooling such as CSPM, CNAPP, IaC scanning, SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, or policy-as-code.

  • Ability to translate security standards and architecture requirements into practical implementation patterns.

  • Familiarity with generative AI, LLM-enabled applications, AI-assisted development, or AI security risks.

  • Strong scripting, automation, workflow design, or tooling integration experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear security guidance for engineering teams.

Desirable-

  • Experience building cloud security guardrails, landing zone controls, reusable modules, or automated remediation workflows.

  • Experience supporting regulated environments or environments with strict customer, contractual, or compliance obligations.

  • Familiarity with AI security frameworks and guidance such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, NIST Generative AI Profile, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, or Cloud Security Alliance AI security guidance.

  • Experience with RAG architecture, AI agents, vector databases, AI APIs, prompt engineering, or AI application threat modelling.

  • Experience building security knowledge assistants, prompt libraries, AI-assisted review workflows, or security automation.

Why Join Us?

Join our team and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. If you are ready to advance your career and make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

title: Youth Program Officer II- $5,000 Sign on Incentive
description:
Job Posting Title:

Youth Program Officer II- $5,000 Sign on Incentive

Department:

Youth Services Center

Location:

5100 SECOND ST NW

Pay:

Union Rate: $29.70

Close Date:

September 12, 2026

Employees at Bernalillo County enjoy the ability to team up with each other to build a high quality of life for our county residents, communities, and businesses. In addition to being an organization with a strong focus on work-life balance, building a culture of flexibility, learning, and belonging the County offers many benefits. Employees of Bernalillo County enjoy many thoughtful rewards such as, but not limited to generous leave accruals; career development opportunities; remote & flex-work options as appropriate; longevity pay; education assistance program; health benefits; lucrative retirement; and so much more.

The classification, under general supervision of a Program Manager, provide direct supervision, care and treatment of residents who are in the custody of the Youth Services Center or its programs.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Maintain security, order and discipline to prevent disturbance, escapes and ensure the safety of residents, staff and the community.
2. Serve as first line lead-worker to ensure shifts are fully staffed and that maintenance of units and facility security are maintained including resident searches and facility inspections.
3. Conduct and participate with in-service training and staff development programs.
4. Assist in training, assigning, and leading subordinate staff.
5. Evaluate, recommend and implement programs to educate residents in daily living skills, social skills and work/study habits.
6. Counsel resident’s in-group and individual sessions.
7. Review youth files/records to insure accurate, updated documentation and provide oral and written reports to the Program Manager.
8. Assign and monitor activities of residents; supervise residents in physical education and recreational activities.
9. Transport residents to court, hospitals or other facilities and service locations outside of the Youth Services Center.
10. Physically restrain violent residents, and if necessary, pursue residents on foot, in the case of escape attempts.
11. Assure for appropriate shift transition, including but not limited to accumulation of all pertinent documents, staffing issues, resident count and equipment and keys.
12. Initiate contacts with parents, legal guardians, Probation and Parole Officers and other agencies.
13. Any one position may not include all duties listed. However, the allocation of positions will be determined by the amount of time spent in performing the essential duties listed above.
14. Perform other operational job-related duties and on the job training as required or assigned.

*The above information on this job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities required of all employees assigned to this job.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Associate’s Degree in Law Enforcement, Criminology, Psychology or related field in addition to one (1) year related experience working in a lockdown, secure or correctional facility. Any equivalent combination of related education and/or experience may be considered for the above requirements.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

SCREENING AND COMPLIANCE

The offer of this Bernalillo County position requires compliance with the following:

1. Employee must successfully complete the post-offer employment medical examination and background investigation.
2. Employee must comply with the safety guidelines of the County.
3. Employee must complete required FEMA training(s) as assigned to position.
4. Employee must undergo 120 initial hours of on-the-job training, including State Juvenile Code and “A Level” Restraint Training. Employee must undergo re-certification in these areas every six months.
5. Employee must comply with Bernalillo County safety policy requirements to include use of an OSHA approved respirator when required.
6. Employee must have a valid New Mexico driver’s license by employment date and maintain a valid NM driver’s license while employed in this position.

WORKING CONDITIONS

1. Duties are performed primarily indoors (90%) with some outdoor work (10%). Indoor duties are performed in a temperature-controlled environment. Outdoor duties typically involve transportation of residents and recreational activities with residents.
2. Work hazards or potential work hazards include possibility of personal injury from violent residents or heavy exertion activities while restraining or pursuing residents.
3. Employee may be required to do shift work.
4. Work hazards or potential work hazards include working in assignments and areas possibly exposed to infectious disease which require the use of an OSHA approved respirator.

EQUIPMENT, TOOLS, AND MATERIALS

1. Utilizes computers and communication equipment daily.
2. Utilizes recreational/sports equipment, facility keys, handcuffs and shackles on a frequent basis.
3. Worker handles fire extinguishers and oxygen equipment on an occasional basis.
4. Operates a County vehicle as necessary.
5. Must be able to use when appropriate an OSHA approved respirator to include medical evaluation for respirator use and fit testing for proper sealing.

title: Fluids Analyst II - Lunar Permanence
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

Blue Origin is hiring a Fluids Analyst to design and optimize the Gas Subsystem for the Lunar Transfer Stage spacecraft. You'll own the complete lifecycle—from requirements and interface definition through conceptual design, detailed design, component development, assembly, verification testing, and operations. This is a high-impact role where your thermal/fluids expertise directly supports humanity's return to the Moon.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and maintain transient fluids simulation models of the gas subsystem using Thermal Desktop FloCAD and Sinda/Fluint
  • Provide strategic guidance on hardware optimization, mission operations, and control logic
  • Lead trade studies across Gas Subsystem and neighboring subsystems
  • Define requirements and plan verification testing to validate hardware performance in relevant environments
  • Support the complete lifecycle of the Transporter vehicle from initial definition through in-flight operations
  • Drive design iteration through data-informed feedback and optimization

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field
  • 3+ years of thermal/fluids analysis experience
  • Proficiency in Thermal Desktop FloCAD and Sinda/Fluint with strong FORTRAN user-logic skills
  • Deep understanding of Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, and Thermodynamics
  • Hands-on experience with first-order and Excel-level fluids calculations

Desired Qualifications:

  • Advanced Engineering degree
  • Prior spacecraft fluid systems experience
  • CFD expertise (ANSYS Fluent, FLOW3D)
  • Fluid network analysis tools (AFT Arrow/Fathom)
  • Experience with cryogenic, two-phase, and gaseous fluid systems
  • Hydrogen and oxygen systems background
  • Process automation scripting skills (VBA, MATLAB, Python, FORTRAN)

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Digital Delivery Team provides enterprise-wide support to large programs and strategic initiatives, enabling them to deliver at scale. As an embedded partner, we collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable operating models, foster self-organizing workflows, and establish journey-level roadmaps and targets. Our goal is to empower teams to achieve key strategic objectives and drive RBC's success.

We're seeking a highly skilled Scrum Master/Delivery Lead to join our dynamic team and lead multiple Agile squads in a large-scale program. As a key member of our diverse and inclusive team, you'll play a critical role in delivering innovative solutions on our proprietary platform, which is essential to driving client acquisition. Our squads are dedicated to leveraging the latest technologies and Scaled Agile practices to achieve exceptional results. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Scrum Master to advance their Agile skills, gain exposure to a large-scale Agile program, and work with cutting-edge technologies. If you're a motivated and experienced Scrum Master looking to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply for this challenging and rewarding role.

What will you do?

  • Promote and drive adoption of Agile Methodologies and Agile Mindset (Drive Business Value, Deliver in Iterations, Collaboration)

  • Remove impediments to deliver outcomes and results through proactive management of external dependencies, critical thinking/problem solving, and development of new solutions or approaches to ongoing challenges

  • Navigate and identify shared IT services required by the team in the delivery of its objectives. Facilitate discussion leading to collective decision-making, goal setting and conflict resolution within the team

  • Continuously seek to improve team performance by promoting joint accountability for results and solving productivity issues. Facilitate and engage in business analysis, user experience and technical conversations across platforms and multiple levels of influence

  • Work in a Scaled Agile Program and collaborate with other scrum masters and squads to work collectively and deliver capabilities on the client acquisition platform

  • Communicate cross functionally, ensuring transparency of progress and outcomes; Report team progress and accomplishment up and across; Facilitate status updates (including project financials and running concurrent Agile projects under fast-paced work environment), product demos and retrospectives

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

  • Proven Scrum Master experience: At least 3 years of experience as a Scrum Master, with a strong track record of applying Scrum principles, practices, and theory to drive team success.

  • Certified Scrum Master or Agile Practitioner: Hold a current certification as a Scrum Master or Agile Practitioner, demonstrating expertise in Agile methodologies and practices.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills: Ability to listen actively, communicate clearly and concisely with confidence, and influence others to achieve common goals.

  • Agile project delivery experience: Experience delivering projects or programs in an Agile environment, with a focus on medium-to-large scale initiatives, using influence to facilitate outcomes.

  • Agile technique expertise: Ability to apply well-documented Agile techniques, such as:

    • User Stories

    • Burndown techniques

    • Acceptance Test-Driven Development

    • Continuous testing

    • SAFe and/or Scaled Agile experience is a plus

  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills: Ability to effectively prioritize own workload, focus on multiple streams of work, and manage competing demands to achieve results.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong IT delivery background: A proven track record of delivering IT projects, with a preference for experience in software development or systems analysis.

  • RBC Agile Management Framework expertise: Experience applying the RBC Agile Management Framework to deliver medium to large complexity projects, including familiarity with the Enterprise Decision Support PAR (Project Approval Request) process.

  • Test Automation expertise: Experience with and/or knowledge of Test Automation tools and approaches, including the ability to design and implement automated testing solutions to improve efficiency and reduce defects.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

  • A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation and pension plan.

  • Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive and highly performing team

  • Opportunities to do challenging work, making a difference and lasting impact on communities.

  • Enjoy a comfortable work environment with the option to dress casually.

  • Network and build lasting relationships with developers from diverse backgrounds from across Canada and the world.

  • TypeScript

  • CSS3

  • Experience building reusable component libraries and design systems.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs and JSON-based integrations.

  • WebSockets / real-time applications

We are looking for someone who can go beyond simply converting designs into screens.

The successful candidate should be able to make technical decisions, design frontend architecture, solve complex UI problems, optimise performance, review code, and own frontend delivery from development through production.

title: National Head, Private Bank Lending
description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit

What you'll be doing

As the National Head, Private Bank Lending, you'll serve as a senior leader within the US Private Banking business, with primary accountability for lending strategy, credit oversight, portfolio health, and end-to-end lending execution. Reporting to the Head of US Private, Personal & Digital Banking, this role will lead the lending agenda for the franchise and work in close partnership with the Chief Banking Officer and other senior leaders to support growth, deliver sound risk management, and ensure an exceptional client and banker experience. You'll serve as the single credit authority and deal execution leader across all lending activity within Private, Personal & Digital Banking (PP&D), structuring deals, owning the end-to-end loan execution process, and ensuring speed, quality, and client experience for every loan transaction. This role is intended for a leader who can build and lead a high-performing lending organization, bring sound judgment to complex situations, and establish an operating model that enables bankers to structure, advise, and execute business in the right way. You'll be empowered to assess the needs of the business, strengthen the lending platform over time, and bring forward ideas that improve speed, quality, consistency, and portfolio performance while maintaining strong first-line credit discipline.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. To successfully perform the work of this role, you'll generally be on-site full-time with flexibility.

How you'll succeed

  • Lead the lending function - Lead the lending function for the Private Banking franchise with broad accountability for credit oversight, portfolio performance, lending execution, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Drive credit approval and portfolio health - Deliver competitive turnaround times, ensure portfolio credit quality, and oversee portfolio health through disciplined first-line risk management, strong credit standards, and proactive identification of emerging issues, concentrations, and performance trends.

  • Structure complex deals - Provide leadership on credit matters across the business, including complex transactions, credit structuring, underwriting, and tailored financing solutions, especially for ultra-high-net-worth and high-net-worth clients.

  • Own loan execution - Manage the process from approval to close, improving decision-making, reducing friction in the process, and enhancing the experience for clients and internal partners.

  • Partner across the franchise - Serve as a senior executive partner alongside the Chief Banking Officer and other business leaders, and collaborate closely with leaders across Private Banking, Personal Banking, Product and Revenue, Risk, Finance, Operations, and other key stakeholders to deliver integrated outcomes and maintain alignment across the franchise.

  • Uphold credit standards - Establish and enforce first-line credit standards, maintain a solutions-oriented culture, and work closely with risk partners to enhance policy and deliver competitive Private Banking solutions in line with CIBC's risk appetite.

  • Build the lending organization - Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team by setting clear expectations, elevating standards, and fostering a culture of accountability, partnership, and practical problem-solving.

  • Measure and improve outcomes - Drive strong execution outcomes through high deal conversion, booking efficiency, client satisfaction, and consistent portfolio performance.

Who you are

  • You have the right education. Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

  • You bring deep industry experience. You have significant executive leadership experience in lending, credit, private banking, commercial banking, wealth management, or a closely related financial services business.

  • You're a strategic and disciplined leader. You have a strong track record of balancing business growth with sound credit judgment, portfolio oversight, and risk management.

  • You bring deep lending expertise. You have strong experience in credit structuring, underwriting, lending execution, and portfolio management, including complex client needs and tailored financing solutions.

  • You're decisive and solutions-oriented. You can structure deals, drive outcomes efficiently, and bring clarity to complex situations while maintaining a strong control environment and high professional standards.

  • You're highly collaborative. You build trusted relationships across business, operations, and risk, and partner effectively with bankers, risk partners, operations teams, and senior executives.

  • You put clients first. You understand the importance of speed, quality, and satisfaction in loan transactions and are focused on delivering an exceptional client and banker experience.

  • You bring strong business and analytical acumen. You combine business judgment with financial and analytical strength, using data and insight to improve credit quality, execution speed, and portfolio outcomes.

  • Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

About The Position

The Engineering and Construction Supervisor is responsible for oversight and management of vendor based construction of electric transmission line and substation facilities or modifications and maintenance of existing transmission facilities.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Works independently in performing all aspects of construction management.

Address issues identified to resolve safety issues, cost overruns or schedule delays. Identify and resolve change requests.

  • Provide constructability expertise in planning and review of specifications, schedule, outage planning and other activities to assure successful project completion and effective utilization of construction materials, resources and techniques.

  • Assist the Project Manager and other project stakeholders with development of the critical path project schedule to ensure realistic and achievable construction activity duration and sequence.

  • Complete a detailed assessment of project requirements, including but not limited to: material, construction access and restoration, construction techniques and jobsite security prior to contractor mobilization.

  • Administer job working rules, workman’s protection assurance (WPA), OSHA and environmental regulations, and ongoing Ameren operating procedures.

Knowledge of materials, methods and tools in the construction and maintenance of electric Transmission and Distribution facilities. Knowledge of general construction processes, principles and activities. Strong leadership, management, analytical, communication and human relations skills. Must be adaptable and flexible. Knowledge of safe work practices and ability to influence safe behaviors of contractors and others. The Engineering and Construction Supervisor works during normal business hours in an office and field environment. Overnight travel may be required multiple days per week, depending on location of construction projects. Subject to call-out and overtime as required for emergency storm restoration and project work.

title: Principal Associate, Data Scientist -Financial Services
description:
Principal Associate, Data Scientist -Financial Services

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love

  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data

  • Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation

  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.

  • Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.

  • Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.

  • A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.

  • Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.

  • Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.

  • A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

title: Contractor Services Supervisor (Transmission)
description:
About Ameren Transmission

Ameren Transmission is dedicated to planning, constructing and safely operating over 8,000 transmission miles across a variety of energy markets. We explore opportunities and develop projects that will enhance reliability, improve system performance and increase access to more diverse generation sources for customers across the country.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical coverage on date of hire

  • 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

  • Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

  • Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

CONTRACTOR SERVICES SUPERVISOR (TRANSMISSION)

About The Position

The Transmission Contractor Services Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day oversight of vendor-based transmission line and substation electric and civil construction crews and the management of this work in accordance with applicable contracts and agreements, and investigation and resolution of stakeholder complaints. Additionally, the Contractor Services Supervisor is responsible to assure that vendor's field supervision enforces all applicable Ameren policies, practices and safety rules.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Provide input to project planning and design.
  • Manage, develop, and evaluate contractor crews engaged in the construction, maintenance and inspection of electric system facilities.
  • Provide clear expectations for their performance, to include safety and quality through observations and audits..
  • Schedule, assign, and direct the work in a safe, efficient, and effective manner in accordance with the applicable contracts and agreements.
  • Maintain regular contact with contractor supervisory personnel to assess manpower, equipment, tools and material needs for specific projects.
  • Schedule, assign, and manage the work in a safe, efficient, and effective manner in accordance with the applicable contracts and agreements.
  • Monitor and control project budget and schedules to ensure that the proper resources are allocated so that projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • Provide budgetary cost tracking documentation and construction timeline schedules.
  • Document project scope changes and provide project updates as required.
  • Coordinate activities with customers, contractors, stakeholders, and other company departments.
  • Consistently enforce WPA, LOTO, safety rules and conduct Safety Observations with individuals and crews.
  • Consistently enforce appropriate corporate policies with contractor crews as required.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of department and function goals. Identify and implement improvements within the department to control costs and improve productivity and quality.

Qualifications

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred. Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or construction management related discipline preferred. Five or more years of relevant experience in electric transmission or electric distribution required, OR Five or more years of relevant experience in a heavy industrial or military environment including a minimum of three years in a supervisory or team/contractor leadership role required. Journeyman line or journeyman substation experience preferred. Utility experience preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

The Contractor Services Supervisor’s work environment includes office and field. Overnight travel may be required, for multiple days per week, depending on location of construction projects. Subject to call-out and overtime as required for emergency storm restoration and project work.

Knowledge of Microsoft Office, general computer skills, proficiency with mobile devices, and proficiency with project construction schedules required. Strong leadership, management, analytical, communication and human relations skills preferred. Must be adaptable and flexible. Project and/or Construction Management skills preferred. Basic knowledge of Oracle and ArcGIS, systems preferred.

Additional Information

Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include candidate testing and/or an individual aptitude or skill-based assessment. Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

Compensation Range:

$88,500.00 - $137,200.00

At Ameren, base salary is one component of a competitive compensation package for employees. Our pay ranges are broad to allow for movement within our organization and to accommodate different skill sets and levels of expertise. We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the base salary offered. title: Software Engineer, Backend - GrabDefence
description:
About Grab and Our Workplace


Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.


Get to know our Team


We're looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Backend Software Engineer to join the GrabDefence team in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia. You will design, develop, and maintain backend systems that power our defense and security solutions. You will work with a talented team of engineers to build scalable, efficient, and secure infrastructure that protects our users and organization.


Get to know the Role


As a Backend Software Engineer on the GrabDefence team, you will help build and maintain the backend systems that protect Grab financial ecosystem, especially on digi-banks. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, learning from experienced teammates, and contributing to products that operate at large-scale. You will be reporting to Senior Software Engineering Manager, Trust. You will work with software engineers, product managers, data scientists, and security partners. Together, you will develop services that power capabilities such as name screening, transaction screening, fraud detection and prevention, and other risk management solutions. In addition to building new features, you will help ensure our systems remain reliable through operational support, maintenance, bug fixing, and participation in the team's on-call rotation.We are looking for someone with a engineering foundation, curiosity to learn, and experience building scalable, reliable backend systems. You are comfortable working in a collaborative environment, of your work, and both the products you build and your technical skills.


This role is onsite based in our Petaling Jaya, Malaysia office.


The Critical Tasks You Will Perform



  • You will design and develop scalable backend services and APIs using modern programming languages and frameworks

  • You will architect and implement microservices-based solutions that meet performance and reliability requirements

  • You will improve database queries and design efficient data models for both SQL and NoSQL databases

  • You will collaborate with teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions

  • You will implement security best practices and conduct code reviews to ensure code quality and system integrity

  • You will develop and maintain comprehensive unit tests and integration tests to ensure code reliability

  • You will participate in system design discussions and contribute to technical documentation


What Essential Skills You will Need



  • You have 3+ years of professional backend software development experience

  • You have proficiency in at least one backend programming language (Java, Python, Go, C++, or similar)

  • You have experience with RESTful API design and development principles

  • You have experience with relational and non-relational database systems

  • You have demonstrated knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems

  • You have proficiency with version control systems (Git)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

  • You have experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • You have familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

  • You have knowledge of message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

  • You have background in security or defense-related systems

  • You have Agile/Scrum development experience


Life at Grab


We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:



  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.


What We Stand For At Grab


We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Maintenance Group Supervisor
description:
We are ERock!

ERock is a leader and innovator in distributed energy. ERock has responded to long-term trends in electricity by becoming the first smart-grid supplier to US energy consumers. The company installs, operates, and integrates its highly flexible, low-cost, and quick-response distributed generation to increase reliability and stability, reduce costs and decrease carbon footprint.


At ERock, our backup generators ensure that customers will never be without power, allowing their business to operate normally when there is an outage in the area. Our innovative approach provides customers with highly reliable, ultra-clean backup generation at a fraction of the cost of traditional backup solutions. We seek those who share our commitment to customer service, innovation, and ingenuity.


Position Overview:

The Maintenance Supervisor is responsible for leading the daily execution of maintenance activities at ERock's McCloud Power Station in El Paso, TX. This individual will provide frontline leadership to maintenance technicians, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with production priorities. The Maintenance Supervisor will partner closely with Operations, Production, Engineering, and Planning to maximize equipment reliability, minimize downtime, and promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily maintenance operations for assigned shifts, ensuring work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company standards.
  • Conduct start-of-shift meetings to review safety topics, work assignments, maintenance priorities, schedule changes, and operational updates.
  • Coordinate daily maintenance activities with the Maintenance Planner, balancing preventive maintenance, corrective work orders, available resources, and production priorities.
  • Assign work based on technician skill level, qualifications, workload, and business needs while ensuring employees clearly understand job expectations and hazards.
  • Maintain a visible presence on the production floor by providing coaching, guidance, and field leadership throughout the shift.
  • Perform routine job observations and quality audits to verify work is completed safely, accurately, and in compliance with company procedures.
  • Review and authorize safe work permits within assigned authority, ensuring hazards, PPE requirements, and job scope are properly identified prior to work execution.
  • Ensure Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and other energy isolation requirements are properly implemented and consistently followed.
  • Monitor work progress, resolve maintenance issues, adjust priorities as needed, and communicate schedule changes with Operations and Production leadership.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts for equipment failures while supporting root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions to improve equipment reliability.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop maintenance technicians while managing employee performance, attendance, safety, and accountability in partnership with Human Resources.
  • Promote a strong safety culture through regular coaching, hazard recognition, compliance with company policies, and continuous reinforcement of safe work practices.
  • Document completed work, outstanding maintenance items, equipment concerns, and shift turnover information to ensure effective communication across teams.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on maintenance processes, equipment uptime, reliability, and overall plant performance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Product
description:
Senior Data Engineer - Product

<br>

Job Description

<br>

Exciting opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer to join Domain – CoStar in a period of great opportunity and growth. You will have a direct impact on the continued success of Domain-CoStar in the APAC region. Leveraging the largest reality data sets in the local market, to enhance Domain-CoStar’s product service offering and refine internal business practices.

The purpose of this role is to build data platform capabilities for batch and streaming pipelines on our Lakehouse and develop data assets that serve as the source and authority for data-driven decisions and analytics used across the business. You will design, develop and operate a data platform and data

pipelines which serve Domain’s products and internal data teams like data product, data science, data analytics and ML/AI.

What you’ll do

  • Solution Design: Design and build re-usable, scalable data solutions and assets on a modern Lakehouse platform across a constantly evolving landscape of products and internal data teams.
  • Pipeline Development: Build and maintain robust, reliable pipelines using DBT, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, Databricks and AWS services.
  • Streaming & Real-Time: Develop real-time data pipelines using Apache Kafka and Apache Flink to support low-latency, event-driven use cases.
  • Data Integration: Connect to a wide variety of internal and external sources via multiple methods (SaaS solutions, APIs, direct connections, streaming) on cloud architecture.
  • Cloud Data Architecture: Architect and implement data solutions on AWS, Snowflake and Databricks, applying best practices for cloud-native data warehousing and cost-efficiency.
  • Lakehouse Architecture: Build and optimise open Lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg, managing schema evolution, partitioning, and performance.
  • Modern Data Modelling: Apply modern data modelling practices that evolve with the business in an agile environment.
  • Performance & Cost: Write and optimise complex SQL and Spark workloads to keep solutions efficient in both time and cost.
  • Data quality and governance
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work closely with data scientists, analysts, product managers, and engineers across the Domain Group to deliver data solutions that drive business value.
  • Continuous Improvement: Challenge the status quo — proactively identify opportunities to improve data processes, reduce costs, and increase reliability.

Essential:

  • At least 5+ years of hands-on commercial experience in software or data engineering.
  • 4+ years of strong development experience in SQL and Python.
  • Proven experience with data integration and orchestration tools, including Apache Airflow, DBT, and AWS Glue.
  • Expert on some of the modern cloud data platforms and architectures, such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Lakehouse architecture
  • Experience designing and building data solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience working with semi-structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong data modelling skills with the ability to evolve models in an agile environment.
  • Hands-on experience building streaming and real-time pipelines with Apache Kafka and Apache Flink.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools such as CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical field

What’s In It For You?

Working at CoStar Group means you'll enjoy a culture of collaboration and innovation that attracts the best and brightest across a broad range of disciplines. We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. As well as having an outstanding working environment, other perks include extra days of annual leave, leadership development programs, LinkedIn Learning, Perkbox discounts and much more!

At CoStar, we recognise the positive value of diversity and promote equality. We aim at all times to recruit the person who is most suited to the job and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds including but not limited to; people of all genders, of all ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, nationalities, religions and beliefs.

About Domain (part of the CoStar Group)

Domain is a leading property technology and services marketplace that is home to one of the largest portfolios of property brands in Australia, including the Domain, Allhomes and Commercial Real Estate (CRE) platforms. In 2025, Domain became part of CoStar Group - a global leader in commercial real estate information, analytics, online marketplaces and 3D digital twin technology. We are dedicated to digitising the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights, and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

Domain is enthusiastically and unapologetically committed to fostering an equitable, inclusive work culture which reflects our customers and communities. We are proactively looking for candidates from all lived experiences, including people with disability, and people of all ages, ethnicities, cultures (including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples), faiths, sexual orientations, and gender identities (including trans and non-binary people).

description:

The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. Our innovations make possible™ the technology shaping the future. To achieve this, we employ some of the best, brightest and most talented people in the world who work together as part of a winning team.

Are you an engineer who is passionate about learning and pushing your own limits? Come join our winning team that is focused on Quality Engineering and Reliability Engineering. We are working with engineers and scientists across business units, and across functions, to develop the next generation products with a relentless focus on quality and reliability.

  • Our engineering know-how is tested every day as we are analyzing failure modes to find the root cause for equipment failures during stress tests in the lab, or at customer sites.

  • Our engineering judgment is in demand every day as we are striving to develop the highest quality manufacturing processes and the most advanced and reliable production machines for our worldwide customers.

  • Our leadership is needed every day as we are driving projects in collaboration with Development, Supply Chain, Pilot Manufacturing, Manufacturing and Customer Engineering.

Job Summary

As the Product Quality and Reliability Engineer, you will report to the Director of Quality and Reliability (Q&R). You will lead multiple quality engineering projects in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. You will also work with development engineers to ensure the proliferation of Design For Reliability (DFR) methods into our stream of new product developments. You will complete the reliability analysis for new products and plan the reliability validation tests.

Major Responsibilities

  • Drives 8D and FA projects towards successful implementation of solutions.

  • Evaluates, from a reliability standpoint, the materials, properties, and techniques used in design and manufacturing by AMAT and AMAT's suppliers.

  • Performs FMECA and works with supplier and development engineers to enable CRAMS test plans. Leads Part Qualification Process (PQP) at supplier sites.

  • Troubleshoot, analyze non-conformance and failure rate data using advanced business analytics to focus and prioritize the Q&R projects and prepare management reports.

  • Reviews Engineering Change Requests for their impact on Quality and Reliability (Q&R).

Key Competencies

  • Demonstrates depth and breadth of expertise in mechanical/Electrical/systems engineering, mechanisms and components qualification, manufacturing and failure analysis, DFR, electro-mechanical components.

  • Technically astute and detail-oriented. High-energy, hands-on, self-confident leader with a broad knowledge of product development, manufacturing quality and reliability methods.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, personal presence, style, and demeanor, to effectively influence and lead others to find and implement solutions to complex quality and reliability problems.

  • Excellent listening, written and verbal communications skills.

  • Strong desire to learn and grow your career with the organization.

  • Able to travel to supplier sites in the USA and Asia.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering preferred

  • Preferred: Master's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Reliability, or a related field. Certified Quality or Reliability Engineer. Six Sigma certification (Black Belt, Green Belt). Semiconductor capital equipment experience.

  • Experience in Quality and Reliability preferred, strong analytical and problem-solving skills

title: Supply Chain Program Manager
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Supply Chain Program Manager

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 office days a week)

Working Location: Indianapolis, IN

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential. And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

Position Summary:

This is a central role leading projects within the dedicated task force of DeliveryWorks, who is chartered to diagnose and permanently fix the root causes behind chronic delivery failures. As a Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own end-to-end initiatives within a portfolio of projects from problem definition through corrective action closure, serving as the primary integration point across programs, supply chain, planning, procurement, quality, engineering, and manufacturing.

What you will be doing:

  • Serve as the central point of accountability for the assigned delivery improvement initiatives: charter, governance, and outcomes
  • Manage a portfolio of active and potential improvement projects, taking accountability for the schedule, milestones, risk, and regular reporting of progress.
  • Convene and run recurring task force reviews with cross-functional leads (planning, procurement, quality, manufacturing, engineering) to drive issues to closure — not just status updates
  • Maintain communications with stakeholders including status reporting to senior stakeholders as defined in the project governance structure for the assigned projects
  • Manage project changes, such as cancelling projects or changing scope of projects to react to changes in direction
  • Escalate systemic or cross-functional blockers to leadership with clear options and recommendations
  • Validate that implemented fixes eliminate recurrence through follow-up audits
  • Institutionalize permanent fixes into standard work — updated planning parameters, supplier requirements, or process controls — so the task force can eventually stand down
  • Support and/or lead communities of practice across the global DeliveryWorks program management team

Basic Requirements:

  • Associate degree with 7+ years of supply chain or operations experience and program/project management experience, OR
  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of supply chain or operations experience, and program / project management experience, OR
  • Master’s degree or higher with 3+ years of supply chain or operations experience, and program / project management experience, OR
  • JD/PhD, OR
  • 9+ years of supply chain or operations experience, and program / project management experience in lieu of a degree
  • To be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen

Preferred Requirements:

  • Significant experience in supply chain and operations within a manufacturing industry
  • Understanding of ERP, MRP, planning systems, and data tools (Excel required; Power BI/Tableau a plus)
  • Understanding of key supply chain processes such as planning / SIOP, sourcing, manufacturing, delivery and delivery governance (short term interval control, rate readiness, ERP compliance, data integrity management). Logistics, warehousing, and returns experience is not required
  • Strong track record driving cross-functional accountability without direct authority — this role must move people to closure, not just track them
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and complex environments
  • Excellent communication skills

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.

Rolls-Royce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics. We are committed to providing a respectful and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued and everyone can thrive.

  • Document all maintenance activities and parts usage in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

  • Support and monitor contractors working on or near refrigeration systems, ensuring full adherence to company and regulatory safety protocols.

  • Communicate system status, findings, and maintenance recommendations clearly to leadership and cross-functional teams.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of industrial refrigeration experience (ammonia, Freon, and/or CO₂); trade school or equivalent training preferred.

  • Ability to work in extreme temperature environments (−20°F to 100°F) and lift up to 40 lbs.
