title: Brand Protection Specialist, Amazon NAM
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Team and Role:

At Logitech, we design products that have an everyday place in people's lives, connecting them to the digital experiences they care about. We are looking for a data-driven, analytical, and proactive Brand Protection Specialist to protect Logitech’s brand integrity, profitability, and customer experience on Amazon and across the broader e-commerce landscape. The larger team supporting Amazon are a group of diverse minds with complementary skill sets that support each other in a very fast paced environment.

The ideal candidate will own the day-to-day execution of Logitech’s marketplace integrity strategies on Amazon. The role is built on three core pillars: MAP Policy Enforcement, Feature Offer Preservation, and Returns Prevention.

The ideal candidate is a master of data manipulation who can take massive, disparate data sets from multiple internal and external sources and translate them into simple, actionable insights for both internal leadership and external partners. You will act as the primary operator collaborating with Sales and Marketing stakeholders to utilize third-party vendor support and Amazon’s Brand Registry tool to protect Logitech’s digital shelf.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

1. MAP Policy Enforcement

  • Monitor & Track: Monitor minimum advertised price (MAP) compliance across all retail channels, keeping a pulse on market Average Selling Prices (ASPs).

  • Investigate: Identify root causes of price degradation and analyze the impact of rouge pricing behaviors.

  • Enforce: Work closely with third-party data vendors to flag violations and leverage Amazon Brand Registry to submit claims to enforce policy compliance.

2. Featured Offer Preservation

  • Root Cause Analysis: Track, analyze, and own the metrics behind Lost Featured Offer (LFO) on Amazon

  • Grey Market Mapping: Perform targeted test buys, track serial numbers, and map out the supply chain flow of grey market and unauthorized goods entering the Amazon channel.

  • Remediation: Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Sales, and Supply Chain to eliminate unauthorized supply chain leaks and improve the LFO% and associated KPIs.

  • Pricing Strategy: Analyzed promotional pricing curves to identify thresholds triggering price arbitrage, optimizing discount models to protect brand margin and channel integrity.

3. Returns Prevention

  • Data Analysis: Analyze Amazon return codes, customer reviews, Voice of the Customer (VoC) insights, defect data, and pricing elasticity curves to identify marketplace trends and product pain points.

  • PDP Optimization: Partner with Logitech Marketing and Amazon account teams to optimize Product Detail Page (PDP) content, update consumer messaging, and improve A+ content to better align customer expectations and reduce return rates.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience in working on brand protection related projects, ideally in a multinational technology company.

  • Exceptional ability to extract, clean, and manipulate data from multiple, fragmented sources (e.g., Amazon Vendor/Seller Central, third-party scraping tools, internal ERPs).

  • Strong track record of translating complex data sets into simple, concise, and visually compelling presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to create strong stories through the use of innovative technologies (such as AI) for presentation purposes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including presentation skills.

  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet strict deadlines.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Jora Malaysia will close on 9th September 2026. Thank you for being with us, we are cheering you on as you continue your career journey.

Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract
Experience: 5–8+ years
Nationality: Malaysian Citizens Only

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Frontend Developer / UI Engineer to build scalable, high-performance, and modern web applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take ownership of frontend architecture, complex UI development, performance optimisation, reusable component design, and integration with backend services.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React/TypeScript, modern frontend architecture, API integration, and enterprise-grade UI engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, responsive, and high-performance web applications.
  • Take ownership of frontend architecture and technical implementation.
  • Build reusable, maintainable, and modular UI components.
  • Develop complex user interfaces using React.js and TypeScript.
  • Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Implement state management and efficient data handling.
  • Translate UI/UX designs and business requirements into high-quality production-ready interfaces.
  • Develop responsive applications across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
  • Implement frontend security best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews and maintain high coding standards.
  • Write unit, integration, and component tests.
  • Troubleshoot complex frontend issues and perform root‑cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, backend engineers, QA engineers, architects, and product teams.
  • Contribute to frontend technical standards, architecture decisions, and development best practices.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, estimation, and technical discussions.

Required Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5–8+ years of professional frontend development experience.
  • React.js
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture and design patterns.
  • Experience building reusable component libraries and design systems.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs and JSON-based integrations.
  • Experience with state management such as Redux, Zustand, Context API, or equivalent.
  • Experience with Git and modern development workflows.
  • Good understanding of frontend build tools such as Vite, Webpack, or equivalent.
  • Experience writing automated frontend tests using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.

Tough / Niche Technical Skills

Candidates with experience in the following will be strongly preferred:

  • Micro-frontend architecture
  • Design systems and reusable UI component libraries
  • Web performance optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Advanced TypeScript and frontend architecture
  • WebSockets / real‑time applications
  • OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect and frontend security
  • Accessibility standards such as WCAG
  • CI/CD pipelines for frontend applications
  • Docker and cloud-based deployment environments
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise APIs
  • Experience working with AI-powered UI features or AI application interfaces is an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who can go beyond simply converting designs into screens.

The successful candidate should be able to make technical decisions, design frontend architecture, solve complex UI problems, optimise performance, review code, and own frontend delivery from development through production.

title: Life Safety Supervisor
description:
Kaweah Health is a publicly owned, community healthcare organization that provides comprehensive health services to the greater Visalia area in central California. With more than 5,000 employees, Kaweah Health provides state-of-the-art medicine and high-quality preventive services in our acute care hospital, specialized health centers and clinics. Our eight-campus healthcare district has 613 beds and offers comprehensive health services across a broad continuum of care.

It takes a special person to work for Kaweah Health. We serve a region where the needs are great, which makes the rewards even greater. Every day, we care for people facing unique challenges and in need of healing. Throughout it all, our focus is to make a difference, and we do — in the health of our patients, our loved ones, and our community.

Benefits Eligible

Full-Time Benefit Eligible

Work Shift

Day - 8 Hour or less Shift (United States of America)

Department

8490 Safety-HICS

Responsible for regulatory oversight of all environment of care/non-clinical functions, including but not limited to: scheduling inspections required by Joint Commission, California Title 20 regulations, Haz Mat inspections and reports, OSHA, Life Safety Inspections and drills, review of related reports, and resolution of deficiencies noted on such reports. Partners with the Facilities Department to accomplish these tasks. Reports to the Director of Physical Environment. Attends committees as assigned and applicable.

QUALIFICATIONS


License /Certification

Required:
Valid California Driver’s License. Must provide DMV report prior to offer being made. No driving infractions 5 years prior to hire or during time in this job. Infractions include DUI, Suspended or Revoked License, Reckless Driving.
Kaweah Health approved crisis intervention training within 60 days of hire/transfer.


Preferred: Certified Life Safety Specialist- Healthcare within 60 days of hire/transfer
OSHA 10 Certification within 60 days of hire/transfer


Experience

Required:
Three years’ experience in working with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Joint Commission Environment of Care (EOC), Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Center for Medicare Services (CMS).
Three years management experience or any combination of education, training, and experience which demonstrates ability to perform the duties and responsibilities as described


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential


Ensures Kaweah Health safety operations and a safe environment for employees, patients, and visitors.

Assists the department director to plan, organize, supervise, coordinate and control the activities of the Life Safety team and its responsibilities.

Assigns job responsibilities to staff on duty.

Monitors daily workflow and work assignments to insure tasks are performed in a timely manner and checks for any inappropriate practices.

Ensures staff are in place working at start of shift, taking appropriate breaks at proper times, and working throughout entire shift up to clocking out.

Provides training for new staff, and maintains competencies of all applicable staff.

Develops and maintains effective working relationships with all District staff and leaders.

Assists in maintaining up-to-date Kaweah Health safety policies and procedures to ensure the minimization of potential accidents and compliance with regulatory agencies.

Assists in providing Safety Orientation of Kaweah Health policies and procedures to all new facilities employees and assists in department monthly and annual Safety in-services for continuous education. (Areas specific to general safety, disaster preparedness, hazardous materials management, etc.).

Maintains up-to-date knowledge in the field of safety as it relates to medical institutions and as required by Joint Commission, state hospital licensing agencies, OSHA and other applicable federal, state and local agencies. Ensures compliance with all applicable laws/regulations.

In conjunction with the education department ensures hospital staff have attended programs and are prepared for the various regulatory inspections, including but not limited to Joint Commission, Fire Marshall visits, County and State visits.

In conjunction with the facilities department and the Environmental of Care ensures the organization is prepared for the various regulatory inspections, including but not limited to Joint Commission, CMS, CDPH, Fire Marshall visits, County and State visits.

Assists in maintaining the facilities department Hazardous Materials and chemical inventories along with keeping SDS’s updated. Monitors an annual assessment of the hazardous material handling program.

Coordinates hazardous waste storage and disposal procedures, the completion of required documentation, and monitoring of licensed haulers with the assistance of the EOC chairperson, and working with Purchasing and Finance.

In conjunction with the appropriate Facility Staff, monitors the Performance Improvement indicators for the, Life Safety and Critical testing documentation, PM’s and etc.

Coordinates and assists with trend analysis and problem solving for all safety concerns. On a quarterly basis, prepares Safety Performance Improvement results to be presented to the Environment of Care Committee and others as necessary.


Coordinates hazard surveillance rounds and recommends corrective actions. Notifies department of issues and tracks/trends responses. Conducts Interim Life Safety rounds in construction areas and ensures compliance with Life Safety Codes.

Issues and tracks Fire Wall permits and rechecks work performed to insure fire wall penetrations have been installed/sealed to code. Inspects and insures fire walls are sealed and kept to code on a regular basis.

Ensures the hospital’s EPA License and “Permit by Rule” registrations are kept up to date in conjunction with Finance. This includes monitoring the credentials of the licensed hauler.

Assists in the development of the Annual Assessments for the seven Environment of Care and disaster programs with the assistance of Purchasing and Finance departments.

Reviews all EOC related inspection reports and related resolution of identified issues on such reports.

Schedules routine and emergency maintenance on EOC related equipment such as fire alarms, sprinklers, Medical gas systems, etc.


Additional

Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care and services appropriate to the population served on the assigned unit or work area.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Pay Range

$36.00 -$54.00

If you want to use your talents alongside people who face each day with courage and purpose, in an environment that empowers you to do your absolute best, this is where you belong.

*UP TO A $10,000 SIGN ON BONUS AVAILABLE FOR QUALIFIED CANDIDATES*

The right team of nurses is capable of transforming health care. Monument Health nurses are professional and passionate, and we support one another. Whether you are newly graduated or have years of experience as a RN, we are looking for positive, hardworking, and considerate Registered Nurses who thrive in a fast-paced work environment providing high quality care.

As a Registered Nurse at Monument Health, you will be valued as an essential team member providing compassionate patient focused care. You will discover a culture of teamwork, professionalism, mutual respect, and— most importantly— a life-changing career. You will make a difference. Every day.

Our Registered Nurses facilitate relationship-centered, compassionate, quality care to patients through competent clinical practice and the application of the healing and science of professional nursing. You will be an active contributor in the prevention or resolution of illness, disability or injury, alleviation of suffering, and advocacy in the care of individuals in conjunction with interdisciplinary teams of healthcare providers, family members, and support systems. You will exercise independent judgement in utilizing the nursing process to assess, diagnose, identify outcomes, plan, implement, and evaluate direct patient care in accordance with ANA Standards of Professional Nursing Practice, institutional policies and procedures, applicable laws, and regulations.

Our vision at Monument Health is to be one team, to listen, to be inclusive, and to show we care. To do the right thing. Every time. If you share this philosophy, we hope you’ll join us.

Monument Health offers competitive wages and benefits on qualifying positions. Some of those benefits can include:

*Supportive work culture

*Medical, Vision and Dental Coverage

*Retirement Plans, Health Savings Account, and Flexible Spending Account

*Instant pay is available for qualifying positions

*Paid Time Off Accrual Bank

*Opportunities for growth and advancement

*Tuition assistance/reimbursement

*Excellent pay differentials on qualifying positions

*Flexible scheduling

Job Description

Essential Functions:
Utilizes the ANA Nursing Process (2010) to perform the following functions:

  • Collects comprehensive data pertinent to the Healthcare consumer’s health and/or the situation.
  • Analyzes the assessment data to determine the diagnosis or the issues.
  • Identifies expected outcomes for a plan individualized to the Healthcare consumer of the situation.
  • Develops a plan that prescribes strategies and alternatives to attain expected outcomes.
  • Implements the identified plan. Ensures patient progression along plan.
  • Coordination of Care – coordinates care delivery.
  • Health Teaching and Health Promotion – employs strategies to promote health and a safe environment.
  • Consultation – the advanced practice registered nurse and the nursing role specialist provide consultation to influence the identified plan, enhance the abilities of others and effect change.
  • Evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.

Follows the ANA Standards of Professional Performance (2010):

  • Systematically enhances the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice
  • Attains knowledge and competency that reflects current nursing practice
  • Evaluates one’s own nursing practice in relation to professional practice standards and guidelines, relevant statutes, rules, and regulations
  • Interacts with and contributes to the professional development of peers and colleagues
  • Collaborates with patient, family and others in the conduct of nursing practice
  • Integrates ethical provisions in all areas of practice
  • Integrates research findings into practice
  • Considers factors related to safety, effectiveness, cost and impact on practice in the planning and delivery of nursing services
  • Provides leadership in the professional practice setting and the profession
  • Practices in an environmentally safe and healthy manner
  • Supports purpose, vision, and values of Monument Health.
  • Practices within the legal scope of a Registered Professional Nurse as outlined by the state in which employment occurs and delivers competent care consistent with standards / policies, laws, regulators/accreditation/certifying organizations.
  • Abides by the Provisions of the Code of Ethics for Nurses (ANA 2010).

Proficiently uses applicable technology and software to:

  • Support and document nursing activities and patient care.
  • Access other work-related applications necessary to be an engaged and active associate of the organization, such as company email, iLearn modules, employee engagement surveys, benefits and compensation information, and policies and procedures.
  • Continuously seeks out opportunities to improve the quality of patient care delivery through innovative and creative problem solving.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Education - Completion of a nursing education program that is approved by a board of nursing
Certifications - Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification - American Heart Association (AHA) - Within 60 days of hire or transfer; Registered Nurse (RN) - South Dakota Board of Nursing

Preferred:
Experience - 5+ years of Registered Nurse Experience
Education - Bachelors degree in Nursing

Workplace Experience Coordinator

The Workplace Experience Coordinator is a key member of the Cushman & Wakefield onsite account team for the client. This individual is part of a broader Workplace Experience team that aims to ensure employees feel productive, engaged, and well supported in the workplace, and that they are able to thrive in a dynamic environment.

This individual will also be responsible for ensuring daily space readiness, so employees can be productive without friction or challenges. The Coordinator will function as the “eyes and ears” of the workplace - proactively identifying and solving issues before they pose a challenge to an employee.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
In this role as the Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build and operate QL Group’s enterprise data platform on Microsoft Fabric, delivering reliable, high-quality data that powers analytics, AI, and self-service BI across the organisation. You will work on Lakehouse architecture, data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality, performance optimisation and reusable analytics-ready data assets.

What You’ll Be Driven To Do

Build and enhance QL Group’s enterprise Lakehouse platform using Medallion Architecture principles.

Develop and optimise data ingestion from ERP, manufacturing, supply chain, finance and other enterprise systems.

Design, schedule and monitor ETL/ELT pipelines to ensure timely, accurate and reliable data delivery.

Apply data governance, access control and data quality standards to keep enterprise data secure and trusted.

Partner with business and IT stakeholders to translate requirements into effective analytics solutions, improving data accessibility, self-service adoption, and overall user satisfaction.

Deliver high-quality technical work on assigned projects, share expertise, and mentor junior team members to help raise data literacy across teams.

Support performance, cost optimisation and continuous improvement across the data platform

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Data Engineering or a related field. A Master’s degree or relevant professional certification (e.g. Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Engineer, Power BI Data Analyst, Databricks, or AWS/GCP data certifications) is an added advantage.

Minimum 4–6 years of hands‑on experience in data engineering, BI, data warehousing or analytics.

Proven track record in delivering enterprise data pipelines, ingestion and integration frameworks, and analytics platforms within a complex, multi-system environment (ERP, financial, manufacturing, supply chain, and commercial systems).

Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Python and PySpark. Knowledge of Lakehouse design, Medallion Architecture, Parquet/Delta formats and dimensional data modelling.

Experience with data ingestion from enterprise systems, APIs, flat files and databases using CDC or incremental loading.

Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with a practical, service-oriented mindset.

Willing to be based at Shah Alam, Selangor.

At QL, sustainability and innovation go hand in hand. Join us in building data-driven solutions that support a sustainable agrofood ecosystem and accelerate our digital transformation journey.

title: Managing Director International Tax
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Established in 1980, Berkowitz Pollack Brant (BPB) is a certified public accounting firm with a longstanding presence in South Florida and New York. BPB has earned a strong reputation for delivering high-quality tax, assurance, and advisory services and has been consistently recognized among the top 100 accounting firms in the United States.

Effective January 1, 2026, BPB was acquired by and combined with Baker Tilly, a leading global advisory, tax, and assurance firm. During this transition period, the firm operates as Baker Tilly X Berkowitz Pollack Brant, Advisors + CPAs, reflecting our integration into Baker Tilly’s expansive national and global network, enhanced resources, and broad range of opportunities.

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Position Overview

We are seeking a seasoned international tax professional to join our firm as a Managing Director within Private Client Services. This is a leadership opportunity for an experienced international tax advisor with deep expertise in cross-border private wealth planning, closely held businesses, and high-net-worth individuals and families. The Managing Director will play a key role in shaping the firm’s private client international tax strategy while advising clients on complex U.S. and global tax matters.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a senior advisor to high-net-worth individuals, families, family offices, and closely held businesses on complex international tax and private wealth matters.

  • Lead the design and implementation of tax-efficient inbound and outbound structures for private clients, including cross-border business ownership, family investment structures, and succession planning.

  • Advise clients on the international tax implications of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, including GILTI, FDII, Subpart F, and related international provisions affecting private clients and pass-through entities.

  • Provide strategic guidance on foreign reporting and compliance matters, including Forms 5471, 8865, 8938, FBAR, and other foreign disclosure requirements.

  • Advise on offshore investment planning, repatriation strategies, and global cash-flow planning for private clients and family-controlled enterprises.

  • Partner with firm leadership to grow and expand the Private Client Services international tax practice, including business development, client origination, and cross-selling across tax, advisory, and assurance service lines.

  • Maintain and expand long-term client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor to multi-generational families and their professional advisors.

  • Collaborate closely with Partners, Principals, Directors, and Managers to deliver integrated, high-quality client solutions.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing international tax teams, including Managers, Senior Managers, and Directors, and play an active role in talent recruitment and retention.

  • Monitor global tax developments and proactively assess their impact on private clients, providing timely insights and strategic recommendations.

  • Represent the firm through thought leadership, speaking engagements, and participation in professional and industry organizations focused on private wealth and international tax.

Qualifications:

  • A minimum of ten (10) years of progressive tax consulting experience, with a strong emphasis on international tax and private client services.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; CPA certification required.

  • Advanced degree such as a Master’s in Taxation, LL.M. in Taxation, or JD strongly preferred.

  • Experience with a large public accounting firm or large law firm.

  • Deep expertise in inbound and outbound international taxation as it relates to high-net-worth individuals, families, trusts, estates, and closely held businesses.

  • Extensive experience with international estate and gift tax planning, including foreign trusts (grantor and non-grantor), cross-border wealth transfers, and family structuring.

  • Strong understanding of multinational and pass-through entity taxation, transfer pricing considerations, and foreign tax credit utilization for private clients.

  • Proven leadership experience with a track record of developing teams, managing complex engagements, and growing client relationships.

  • Demonstrated success in business development, practice growth, and executive-level client advisory.

What We Offer:

  • A competitive and equitable workplace.

  • Executive-level career growth opportunities within a growing Private Client Services platform.

  • Access to Baker Tilly’s national and global network, resources, and private wealth capabilities.

  • A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative culture that values leadership, entrepreneurship, and excellence.

  • An environment designed for professionals who thrive on building practices, advising sophisticated clients, and making a lasting impact.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Senior Specialist, Internal Controls
description:
Job Family

Business Control & Financial Planning

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit .

Job Description Summary

Responsible for assisting in the day-to-day execution of the Aegon Americas Sarbanes Oxley controls program within the first line of defense as well as supporting internal control leadership with the oversight of the global country unit SOX responsibilities. Responsible for assisting as a subject matter expert in the identification, assessment, oversight reporting and disclosure of all key controls across the company and to ensure the business procedures and/or financial controls are in compliance with applicable regulatory and corporate standards and practices. Develop and maintain relationships with appropriate business management and process owners, as well as risk management personnel (second line of defense).

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Assist in the effort over the evaluation and design of internal controls and make recommendations for improvement.

  • Conduct and document financial/accounting/actuarial process flows, with a focus on internal controls and Sarbanes-Oxley compliance.

  • Support the execution of management’s SOX risk assessment and scoping activities to ensure proper risk identification, process mapping and controls linkage for a sustainable internal control framework.

  • Assist in leading the development and implementation of goals, policies, priorities and procedures relating to internal controls over financial reporting and SOX.

  • Assist in preparing updates to management, including management control remediation plans.

  • Partner and liaise with external auditors to plan and implement an assessment of the control environment, coordination of timing and execution of process walkthroughs, and a process for timely sharing of potential issues for resolution with respect to internal controls.

  • Develop processes and policies for reporting findings.

  • Collaborate with the first line in development of action plans to assess the adequacy of action taken by management to correct reporting deficient conditions, accepting adequate corrective action and continuing reviews with appropriate management on action considered inadequate until satisfactory resolution.

  • Help coordinate the system to capture and track control deficiencies through all country units, as well as internal and external audit findings to resolution.

  • Help support testing the design and operating effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting.

  • Collaborate and assist in assessing control implications within the Issue Paper process.

  • Support internal controls leadership on the oversight of all global country units.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or relevant field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Eight years of progressive experience in internal controls, audit or risk management within the financial services industry.

  • Experience working with internal controls under Sarbanes Oxley and assessing control related risks.

  • Ability to document and verbally communicate financial reporting processes in a clear and concise manner, including assessment of design and operating effectiveness of controls.

  • Communication skills to educate/raise awareness of foundational elements/methodologies needed to support an internal control framework.


Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA

  • Big 4 public accounting experience working with controls within the Sarbanes Oxley environment

  • Recent experience with a listed U.S. company that is a domestic registrant.


Working Conditions

  • Hybrid (In Office: Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays)

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $112,000 - $130,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

title: Physical Vapor Deposition Researcher — Lead Engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

As the Lead Physical Vapor Deposition Researcher, you will lead the development of physical vapor deposition processes for perovskite photovoltaic cells. You will be responsible for process development from first principles through statistical process control, owning recipe design, equipment specification, in-situ monitoring strategies, and yield optimization for your processes. You will lead and mentor other associate researchers and coordinate with the team to translate device architectures into robust process windows.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Develop and optimize PVD processes (thermal evaporation, co-evaporation, sputtering) for perovskite absorber layers, charge-transport layers, and transparent conductive oxides (TCOs)
  • Drive innovation for new processes to improve device performance
  • Design deposition recipes for different materials (e.g. multi-source co-evaporation recipes) for film deposition.
  • Specify, commission, and qualify vacuum deposition equipment for perovskite-specific requirements (source types, substrate heating, in-situ monitoring)
  • Develop in-situ process monitoring and feedback control strategies (QCM, optical reflectometry, residual gas analysis)
  • Establish statistical process control (SPC) for critical film properties such as thickness uniformity, composition, crystallinity, resistivity, surface roughness
  • Lead DOE campaigns to map process-structure-property relationships and define robust process windows
  • Collaborate with the team to translate layer specifications into deposition recipes with appropriate tolerances
  • Mentor and direct the work of 2 associate deposition researchers
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, equipment maintenance protocols, and safety procedures for vacuum systems
  • Analyze film characterization data (XRD, SEM, AFM, XPS, ellipsometry) to correlate process parameters with film quality


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in vacuum thin-film deposition for photovoltaic, semiconductor, or optoelectronic applications
  • Expert-level knowledge of thermal evaporation and/or sputtering process physics (nucleation, growth kinetics, film stress, morphology control)
  • Demonstrated experience with multi-source co-evaporation or sequential deposition of multi-component films
  • Hands-on experience with vacuum system design, operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance (load-locks, cryo/turbo pumps, source design)
  • Proficiency with thin-film characterization techniques (XRD, SEM, profilometry, ellipsometry, 4-point probe)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with vapor-deposited perovskite films (co-evaporation of organic halides and metal halides)
  • Experience with hybrid sequential deposition methods (vapor-assisted solution processing)
  • Knowledge of TCO deposition (ITO, FTO, AZO) by sputtering for photovoltaic applications
  • Experience with in-situ optical monitoring or spectroscopic ellipsometry during growth
  • Experience managing or mentoring junior researchers in a lab environment
  • Familiarity with perovskite degradation mechanisms and how deposition conditions affect stability
  • Familiarity with degradation of perovskite solar cells in the outer space environment
  • Publication record in vacuum-deposited perovskite or related thin-film PV technologies
  • Track record of scaling deposition processes from small-area R&D to larger substrate formats

title: Membership Service Representative
description:
As a thought-leader and best-in-class provider in education, wellness, youth development, and community-building, The YMCA of Metro Atlanta is one of the oldest and most essential non-profits serving in Atlanta. Today, we’re looking for you to join us as we carry out our mission to positively impact lives and communities across the state.

At the Y, we’re an association of like-minded people (staff, volunteers, and members), on the forefront of a movement to ensure that everyone -- especially children -- experience an equal opportunity to reach their full potential. In the course of a year, we provide more than 3,000 children, ages 6 weeks through Pre-K with high-quality literacy and STEAM-infused learning; give 58,000 youth and teens access to sports, aquatics, day and resident camps, teen leadership development programs, and employment opportunities; provide over 200,000 members with programs, services, and facilities to enjoy connection and maintain wellness regardless of age; and engage over 25,000 volunteers and donors from across Atlanta to share in the gift of supporting their communities.

NATURE AND SCOPE:


Under the direction of the Membership Director, a Member Service Representative is responsible for efficiently and effectively carrying out the duties and functions of the Member Service area.

RESPONSIBILITIES (including, but not limited to):

  • Provide excellent service to members, guests, and program participants in the branch and on the phone, contributing to member retention.
  • Welcome members as they enter and leave the YMCA.
  • Greet, engage, and/or provide tours to prospective members and program participants.
  • Support and/or is directly involved in the sale of memberships and/or program registrations.

  • Directly handles and resolves membership concerns and informs supervisor of unusual situations or unresolved issues.
  • Implements the YMCA safety protocols related to branch operations.
  • Provide a leadership role in ensuring member/staff adherence to the safety protocols, with a commitment to positive member and staff safety.
  • Maintain branch and association certifications in CPR/AED, Blood-borne Pathogens, branch orientation, and Branch Emergency procedures.
  • Maintain privacy requirements by not sharing personal information about members including, but not limited to, phone numbers, addresses, program participation, financial information, or personal situations.
  • Adhere to, and implement, all policies and procedures listed in the training manual and as new policies are implemented.
  • Communicate in a positive manner with members, guests, program participants and volunteers. Provide appropriate assistance as needed.

REQUIREMENTS:

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

  • 1+ years of experience in work relating to customer service, either paid or volunteer

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Bending, stooping, standing, lifting, seeing, hearing, keyboard input, sitting.

Employment and Benefits package for this job posting is offered through the YMCA of Metropolitan Atlanta, Inc.

  • Ability to pass a pre-employment background check including Criminal Record check, Drug Screening, motor vehicle record (MVR) and reference check according to company policy.

title: Senior Backend Developer – Java
description:
Jora Malaysia will close on 9th September 2026. Thank you for being with us, we are cheering you on as you continue your career journey.

Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract
Experience: 5–8+ years
Nationality: Malaysian Citizens Only

Job Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer – Java with strong hands‑on experience in designing and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications.

This is a hands‑on engineering role for a developer who can take ownership of backend architecture, complex business logic, API development, system integration, performance optimisation, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Java backend applications.
  • Develop secure and high-performance RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Design and implement reusable backend components and services.
  • Develop microservices and distributed backend applications.
  • Integrate backend services with internal and third‑party systems.
  • Design and optimise database queries, transactions, and data access layers.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root‑cause analysis.
  • Optimise application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Implement appropriate security controls for backend services and APIs.
  • Write unit, integration, and automated tests.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high coding standards.
  • Work closely with Frontend Developers, QA Engineers, Business Analysts, Architects, and DevOps teams.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, sprint planning, and estimation.
  • Support application deployment, release activities, and production issues.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical best practices.

Required Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5–8+ years of professional Java development experience.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with:
  • Spring Boot
  • Spring Framework
  • RESTful APIs
  • Microservices
  • Hibernate / JPA
  • Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean code.
  • Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL Server.
  • Strong SQL and database optimisation skills.
  • Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
  • Experience with unit testing using JUnit, Mockito, or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of API security, authentication, and authorisation.

Tough / Niche Technical Skills

Candidates with experience in the following will be strongly preferred:

  • Microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other event‑driven messaging platforms.
  • API Gateway and service‑to‑service communication.
  • Redis or other caching technologies.
  • Docker and Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect.
  • Performance tuning and load optimisation.
  • High‑availability and fault‑tolerant application design.
  • Observability tools such as ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience working with large‑scale enterprise applications.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a backend engineer who can go beyond writing Java code — someone who can design services, solve complex technical problems, understand system architecture, optimise performance, and take ownership of backend delivery from development through production.

title: Production Planning Specialist II
description:
Nordson Industrial Coating Solutions, a global leader in Industrial Coating Solutions, is seeking an experienced and highly motivated individual to join our team. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we are looking for candidates who share that same commitment.

Summary of the role

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your ideas and contributions will be valued and respected.

The Production Planner is responsible for planning and maintaining appropriate material levels to support the production schedule and meet customer‑requested delivery dates. This role coordinates the introduction of new products into the factory and schedules production orders to achieve optimal levels of customer service, inventory efficiency, and asset utilization. The Production Planner also provides consumption and forecast analysis for their assigned area and uses this data to optimize inventory levels and key delivery performance metrics.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Analyze MRP reports and take appropriate action. Create and release production orders on a daily basis to achieve the production plan and customers requested delivery date. Create purchase requisitions on a daily basis to achieve the production plan and to meet our customers requested delivery date.
  • Interaction and feedback with engineering and production teams on upcoming work and potential issues due to material availability.
  • Schedule and re-schedule production orders to mitigate changes.
  • Plan new product materials and schedules
  • Perform required functions within SAP to ensure inventory accuracy.
  • Modify safety stock as required.
  • Analyze on a continuous basis the product lead-time, lot size.
  • Level load the work centers whenever possible, communicate under/over load conditions to the shop floor supervisors and manager.
  • Based on current build schedule, escalate material short issues to Supply Chain
  • Consumption and forecast analysis
  • Management and calculation of KPI’s

Education & Experience Requirement:

  • Bachelor’s degree with one year of work experience required; if no degree, 10 years of relevant work experience required.
  • APICS Certification preferred.

Preferred Skills & Abilities:

  • SAP experience required

title: Sr. Art Director, Bergdorf Goodman
description:
Salary Range $136,000 - $183,000*

Job Description:

WHO WE ARE:

Saks Global is the largest multi-brand luxury retailer in the world, comprising Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman and Saks OFF 5TH. Powered by our talented colleagues, we are redefining luxury shopping by offering each customer a personalized experience across our store network and e-commerce platforms. Through strong partnerships with the world’s most esteemed brands, cutting-edge technology and the industry’s most comprehensive luxury customer data, Saks Global is shaping the future of retail.

YOU WILL BE:

The Senior Art Director is responsible for developing compelling editorial imagery for Exemplar Luxury Group. In this role, you will translate creative strategy into elevated visual storytelling across fashion, beauty, and lifestyle, ensuring every asset reflects the sophistication and consistency of the ELG brand.

You will art direct photography and video shoots, oversee the development and refinement of design assets, and collaborate closely with the Creative Director and Lead Art Director, designers, copywriters, marketers, stylists, photographers, and production partners to deliver best-in-class work across digital, social, print, and retail channels. Combining strong conceptual thinking with exceptional attention to design and craft, you will create visually compelling work that supports brand objectives while maintaining the highest standards of design and execution.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Partner with the Creative Director/Lead Art Director to execute the creative vision across integrated campaigns, seasonal advertising, editorial content, lookbooks, events, digital experiences, social media, email, and direct mail.

  • Art direct fashion, beauty, and lifestyle photography and video shoots through final execution, ensuring elevated visual storytelling, exceptional creative quality, and alignment with brand standards.

  • Art direct and design compelling print and digital creative, applying exceptional typography, composition, color, imagery, and luxury retail design principles.

  • Build out creative concepts, mood boards, visual references, layouts, and design explorations that communicate ideas clearly and inspire creative alignment.

  • Collaborate closely with photographers, stylists, producers, designers, copywriters, retouchers, and production partners to deliver best-in-class creative from concept through final execution.

  • Guide image retouching and post-production by reviewing and marking up retouching proofs, providing direction on color, composition, product accuracy, skin tones, and overall image quality to maintain the highest creative standards.

  • Partner with retouchers and post-production teams to ensure consistency, refinement, and visual excellence across all final imagery.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external brand partners to develop co-op and collaborative creative that supports both ELG and partner objectives.

  • Stay informed on fashion, luxury retail, photography, design, and cultural trends, translating insights into fresh, innovative creative solutions.

  • Manage multiple high-profile projects simultaneously, balancing creative excellence, production requirements, timelines, and business objectives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to designers and junior art directors, fostering collaboration, craftsmanship, and creative growth.

  • Ensure all creative assets are production-ready, technically accurate, and executed to the highest standards across print, digital, social, retail, and emerging platforms.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of art direction and design experience within luxury fashion, retail, editorial, or a related creative industry.

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating excellence in integrated campaigns, editorial storytelling, and art direction across print, digital, social, and experiential channels.

  • Proven experience art directing fashion, beauty, and lifestyle photography and video shoots from pre-production through on-set direction and post-production.

  • Expert understanding of typography, composition, color, imagery, and luxury visual design, with a refined eye for craft, consistency, and detail.

  • Strong knowledge of luxury fashion, retail, photography, visual culture, and emerging design trends, with the ability to translate creative inspiration into compelling visual solutions.

  • Extensive experience overseeing image retouching and post-production, providing clear creative direction to ensure all final assets meet the highest standards of quality, consistency, and brand integrity.

  • Strong understanding of print production, color management, digital asset creation, and omnichannel content development.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while balancing creative excellence, production requirements, timelines, and business objectives.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills, with experience partnering effectively across creative, marketing, merchandising, editorial, production, and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience mentoring designers and junior art directors, providing thoughtful creative guidance while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

  • Highly organized with exceptional project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Passion for fashion, photography, art, interiors, architecture, design, and culture, with a curiosity for emerging creative influences and luxury consumer trends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating expertise in art direction, editorial storytelling, typography, layout, and visual design across integrated fashion, luxury, and omnichannel campaigns.

title: Senior Director, Data Analytics
description:
Senior Director, Data Analytics

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s analytics function powers this work with the data, insights, and decision support that drive efficiency, cost savings, and a stronger customer experience.

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Director, Data Analytics you will lead Operations analytics strategy, building and managing a team that will improve operational execution and reduce friction. This role and team is critical to advancing digital transformation at College Board and in the Ops division—building the team’s predictive and decision-oriented analytics models including: forecasting, modeling, cost assessment, optimization, and decision support.

As the leader of a high-performing analytics team, you will set the analytics strategy, define how work is prioritized and delivered, and ensure delivery of data products to support timely execution of various CB products. Working closely with the Executive Director of Customer, Program, Product & Performance Outcomes (C3PO) and partners across Operations, Product, Program, and Technology, you will embed analytics into operational decision-making, identify and address inefficiencies, develop experiments, and mature Operations’ analytics function to champion College Board’s mission.

In this role, you will:

Set vision and strategy (30%)

  • Build the analytics team and strategy. Direct the building of forecasting, optimization, and decision support models to improve customer experience, execution, while reducing costs.

  • Lead the team in driving analysis that surfaces more efficient operational models and translates findings into cost savings and process improvements.

  • Guide the development of models to estimate the effect of a variety of policy changes.

  • Mature Operations’ role within College Board’s data and analytics ecosystem, connecting the team’s work to CB’s strategic vision.

  • Set the team’s technical direction on modern analytic methods (e.g., AI-assisted coding or statistical modeling) and build the function’s capability to scale ahead of where Operations will be in two to three years.

Drive continuous improvement & innovation through cross-functional collaboration and influence (35%)

  • Set the methodology, quality bar, and technical priorities for the team’s predictive and optimization models, forecasts, and decision-support tools. Review outputs and steer direction to improve operational outcomes.

  • Present strategic analytics insights to senior leadership in ways that shift operational decisions towards improved outcomes.

  • Shape outcomes by embedding analytics into Product, Program, and Technology’s operational priorities.

  • Partner with Finance and Program to set budgetary assumptions, goals, cost drivers, and variance tracking.

Lead and Manage the Analytics Team (35%)

  • Hire, onboard, and lead a high-performing analytics team that is responsible for advanced forecasting, modeling, and data analytics.

  • Build the function’s future capability and bench: anticipate the modeling, AI and data-infrastructure skills Operations will need in two to three years and develop talent depth to meet it.

  • Set vision and priorities for the team, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

  • Cultivate an inclusive and high-achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles effectively and provide opportunities for professional development and growth.

  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work.

About You

You have:

  • A combination of education and experience equal to 8–10+ years, including practical data analysis and leading analytics work in a professional setting.

  • Education: A master’s degree in a quantitative or equivalent field (required); a Ph.D. in a quantitative field (strongly preferred).

  • Advanced data analytic skills in forecasting, statistical analysis, and cost assessment.

  • Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, optimization, forecasting, cost assessment, or decision support is strongly preferred.

  • A proven track record of driving operational excellence and delivering measurable results.

  • Experience leading a team and shaping senior-leader analytic decisions.

  • Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and planning skills—you can build a strategy, connect the dots, and build toward the future.

  • Experience applying analytics to operational, customer experience, or process-improvement challenges in government, education, technology, or service-based industry.

  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner’s mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $120,000–$195,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Powder coat painters apply paint in auto and manual booths as directed. The primary responsibility of the painter is to paint product in a safe and efficient manner, with desired film thickness and zero quality defects.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
Are you ready for what’s next?

Come explore opportunities within Brunswick, a global marine leader committed to challenging conventions and innovating next-generation technologies that transform experiences on the water and beyond. Brunswick believes “Next Never Rests™,” and we offer a variety of exciting careers and growth opportunities within united teams defining the future of marine recreation.

Location: Champaign, IL

Workplace Category: Onsite

Travel Required: 5%

Direct Reports: No

Pay Range: $18.00-$27.00

Visa Sponsorship: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Relocation: No

Position Overview:

The Boating Intelligence (BI) Design Lab is seeking a Reinforcement Learning Intern to help establish and advance our capabilities in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for marine vessels and autonomous marine systems.

This role is ideal for a student with a strong foundation in Python and an interest in robotics, autonomous systems, Reinforcement Learning, Simulation and AI. The intern will collaborate with engineers to build the foundations necessary for successful RL projects, including simulation environments, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and experimentation workflows. The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience applying modern machine learning and robotics techniques to real-world marine autonomy challenges.

The Lab is hoping to find someone who can start in the Spring semester of 2027 and work with the lab continuously through the Summer and Fall semesters.

At Brunswick, we have passion for our work and a distinct ability to deliver.

Essential Functions:

  • Assist in the development of reinforcement learning solutions for autonomous marine vessels and intelligent boating applications.
  • Research and evaluate reinforcement learning algorithms, robotics frameworks, and simulation tools.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate training workflows, reward functions, and performance metrics.
  • Perform literature reviews and benchmarking of relevant RL and robotics technologies.
  • Contribute to the creation of reusable development frameworks and best practices for future RL projects.

Diversity of thought and experiences is fundamental when imagining the unimaginable. Certain skillsets/experiences are necessary; however, others can be developed along the way.

Required Qualifications:

  • To be considered for the internship, candidates must have permanent US Work authorization.
  • Current enrollment in a BS or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field at the University of Illinois Urbana Champaign.
  • Demonstrated interest in robotics, autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, or machine learning.
  • Working experience with Python and/or C++
  • Familiarity or experience with Robot Operating System (Ros), Reinforcement Learning and simulation environments.
  • Coursework or project experience related to robotics, machine learning, path planning, motion planning, navigation, controls, or autonomous systems.
  • Portfolio/Resume highlighting a variety of projects.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Work experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, VRX , or similar simulation platforms.
  • Work experience with machine learning, reinforcement learning concepts, including policy optimization, value-based methods, or model-based approaches.
  • Knowledge of marine robotics, and autonomous vehicles is a plus.

Working Conditions:

  • Learning Opportunities: Our Student Program is designed to provide hands-on experience in a professional setting. You will work alongside experienced professionals and get a chance to apply your academic knowledge to real-world tasks.

  • Project Work: The work environment is supportive, collaborative, and conducive to learning. Student co-ops or interns typically work on specific projects or tasks that contribute to the organization’s goals. This may range from supporting larger projects to handling smaller, individual assignments.

  • Hours: Co-ops and Interns are expected to work a full 40-hour work week

  • Feedback and Performance Reviews: As a co-op or intern, you will receive feedback and performance reviews throughout your assignment. We value the importance for interns to understand their progress and areas for improvement.

The pay range for this position is $18.00 - $27.00 per hour. The actual hourly rate offered will vary depending on multiple factors including year in school/credits earned, degree, job-related knowledge/skills, relevant experience, business needs, and geographic location.

At Brunswick, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the salary range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent upon the specifics of the candidate’s qualifications and the business context.

Why Brunswick:

Whatever tomorrow brings, we’ll be at the leading edge. As the clear leader in the marine industry, we're committed to our values and supporting our exceptional people. We offer valuable benefits including a competitive 401(k) plan with company match, health benefits, paid time off, a robust Wellness Program, and much more. title: Supervisor, Manufacturing Engineers
description:
Job Summary

Responsibilities

Duties: Supervise a team of Manufacturing Engineers in troubleshooting daily engineering issues on assigned manufacturing lines serving as the first level of engineering escalation support (20%). Provide ideas for continuous improvement initiatives to optimize manufacturing processes, reduce costs, and improve product quality (15%). Drive improvement projects, including input on funding requests, acquisition, installation, startup, associated documentation, and serve as the communication lead with vendors by partnering with Sr. Manager, Production (15%). Rebuild and upgrade site utility systems and production equipment associated with formulation, filling/capping, lyophilization, packaging, and warehousing/distribution areas as directed by senior leadership (10%). Ensure the validated state of equipment and systems and compliance with all applicable cGMP (including data integrity), OSHA, DEC, EPA, ISO, and local government regulations on assigned lines (10%). Ensure successful transfer of new products and technologies to manufacturing by collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, and R&D (8%). Lead investigations into deviations, non-conformances, and other manufacturing-related issues, developing and implementing corrective and preventive actions (5%). Mentor junior engineers and train them on different engineering systems to achieve the company goals (10%). Assist in the preparation of funding requests per corporate guidelines, including detailed project descriptions, backgrounds, sketches, alternatives, financial data, justifications, quotations, estimates, and schedules (5%). Ensure compliance with company documents, programs and activities related to the Health, Safety, Environment, Energy, and Quality Management Systems (2%).

Requirements: Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field and five (5) years of experience in plant manufacturing within a regulated cGMP environment. Position requires: Experience monitoring performance and performing troubleshooting of mechanical and HMI equipment interfaces; Experience managing improvement projects and troubleshooting manufacturing equipment utilizing industrial automation systems, including computerized and automated machinery, plant mechanical and electrical systems; Experience reading process and instrumentations drawings (P&IDs), wiring diagrams, architectural and construction drawings; Experience ensuring work is performed in accordance with regulated pharmaceutical standards for process and documentation, including cGMP, FDA regulations, and industry standards related to pharmaceutical manufacturing; Experience performing analytical troubleshooting and root cause analysis to identify and resolve underlying issues, ensuring permanent solutions and minimizing equipment downtime; Experience working with Siemens or Allen Bradley control systems and PLC programming of highly automated manufacturing equipment; Experience coordinating and directing contractors and/or team members in site projects.

Salary: $132,921.60 to $144,117.41 per year

Additional Information

We offer an excellent salary and benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage, as well as life insurance, disability, 401K with company contribution, and wellness program.

Please note that joining our team does not create a guaranteed or permanent employment arrangement. All employment is at‑will, meaning both the employee and Fresenius Kabi have the right to end the employment relationship at any time, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws.

Fresenius Kabi is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, disabilities, or protected veteran status.
